skills.source: plaintext JOB SUMMARY Supports the organization’s digital strategy and business operations by designing, developing, enhancing, and maintaining secure, scalable web and mobile applications that improve the experience of members and employees. This role builds and supports internal and external digital platforms—including public websites, intranet, extranet, and digital banking applications—using Optimizely CMS/Commerce (DXP) and Microsoft technologies such as C#, .NET Core, ASP.NET MVC, Web API, WCF, Razor, and ADO.NET, along with modern front-end frameworks including JavaScript, ReactJS, jQuery, Bootstrap, HTML, and CSS. Working in an Agile environment, the position collaborates with cross-functional teams to gather requirements, participate in architecture and design discussions, develop reusable components and APIs, integrate backend systems and databases (SQL Server and Oracle), and ensure applications meet performance, security, and quality standards. Key Responsibilities .NET Application Development: Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade websites and applications using Microsoft technologies including C#, .NET Core, and ASP.NET MVC, with preferred experience in Optimizely CMS/Commerce and Digital Experience Platform (DXP). Build and support enterprise applications using n-tier architecture and established design patterns within the Microsoft technology stack. Front-End Development & User Experience: Develop responsive and accessible user interfaces using JavaScript, jQuery, JSON, ReactJS, Bootstrap, HTML5, and CSS3. Collaborate with UX designers and stakeholders to deliver intuitive digital experiences. Utilize design and prototyping tools such as Figma and Adobe Creative Suite to support UI/UX design validation, usability testing, and iterative design improvements. API Development & Systems Integration: Design and implement SOAP and RESTful APIs using Microsoft technologies including WCF and ASP.NET Web API. Integrate applications with backend systems and services using .NET, OLE DB, and other enterprise data access technologies. Ensure secure, scalable, and reliable system integrations across internal and external platforms. Database Development & Data Modeling: Collaborate with database developers to support data modeling, schema design, and performance optimization. Contribute to database development tasks using Microsoft SQL Server and Oracle as required. Agile Development & Cross-Team Collaboration: Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, including sprint planning, stand-ups, reviews, and retrospectives. Manage development activities using Team Foundation Server (TFS), Azure DevOps, or other enterprise project management tools. Collaborate with cross-functional teams across Marketing and IT— including Project Management, Business Analysts, QA, DevOps, Infrastructure, Security, and Database Administration—as well as onsite and offshore resources to ensure successful solution delivery, alignment with business objectives, and ongoing operational support. Testing, Optimization & Development Standards: Perform unit testing, debugging, performance tuning, and code refactoring to ensure high-quality and maintainable software. Adhere to organizational coding standards, documentation requirements, and secure development practices. Maintain accurate task tracking, code changes, and version control using Git or other enterprise source control systems. Platform Support & Website Maintenance: Support and enhance internal and external digital platforms, including intranet, extranet, public websites, and digital banking applications. Ensure applications meet availability, reliability, and performance standards in accordance with service level agreements (SLAs). Provide troubleshooting and technical support for application-related issues and user requests. Serve as backup administrator for Windows-based web servers when required. Security, Compliance & Documentation: Ensure compliance with organizational policies related to data protection, cybersecurity, network security, and antivirus standards. Maintain accurate service records, system documentation, configuration documentation, and knowledge base articles. Contribute to operational documentation and system runbooks supporting application environments. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or Computer Science Knowledge of financial/banking industry 3+ years of software development experience on the Microsoft technology stack. 3+ years of backend development experience using C#, .NET / .NET Core, ASP.NET MVC, Razor, and ADO.NET. 3+ years of front-end development experience building responsive and interactive user interfaces using JavaScript, jQuery, AJAX, JSON, HTML5, CSS3, and Bootstrap (or similar frameworks). Experience designing and implementing user-centric web applications, with a strong focus on usability and overall UI/UX experience. 3+ years of database development experience using T-SQL with Microsoft SQL Server. 2+ years of experience developing and consuming web services and APIs, including REST and/or SOAP using Web API or WCF. Preferred Qualifications Experience illustrating design concepts through storyboards, workflow diagrams, wireframes, and UI mockup Experience implementing complex business workflows and enterprise application logic. Knowledge of secure application development practices, including implementing security controls in .NET applications and web servers. Familiarity with modern front-end development tools Experience developing solutions using Optimizely CMS/Commerce or Digital Experience Platform (DXP). Experience with modern JavaScript frameworks such as React, Angular, or similar libraries.

skills.source: plaintext JOB SUMMARY Supports the organization’s digital strategy and business operations by designing, developing, enhancing, and maintaining secure, scalable web and mobile applications that improve the experience of members and employees. This role builds and supports internal and external digital platforms—including public websites, intranet, extranet, and digital banking applications—using Optimizely CMS/Commerce (DXP) and Microsoft technologies such as C#, .NET Core, ASP.NET MVC, Web API, WCF, Razor, and ADO.NET, along with modern front-end frameworks including JavaScript, ReactJS, jQuery, Bootstrap, HTML, and CSS. Working in an Agile environment, the position collaborates with cross-functional teams to gather requirements, participate in architecture and design discussions, develop reusable components and APIs, integrate backend systems and databases (SQL Server and Oracle), and ensure applications meet performance, security, and quality standards. Key Responsibilities .NET Application Development: Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade websites and applications using Microsoft technologies including C#, .NET Core, and ASP.NET MVC, with preferred experience in Optimizely CMS/Commerce and Digital Experience Platform (DXP). Build and support enterprise applications using n-tier architecture and established design patterns within the Microsoft technology stack. Front-End Development & User Experience: Develop responsive and accessible user interfaces using JavaScript, jQuery, JSON, ReactJS, Bootstrap, HTML5, and CSS3. Collaborate with UX designers and stakeholders to deliver intuitive digital experiences. Utilize design and prototyping tools such as Figma and Adobe Creative Suite to support UI/UX design validation, usability testing, and iterative design improvements. API Development & Systems Integration: Design and implement SOAP and RESTful APIs using Microsoft technologies including WCF and ASP.NET Web API. Integrate applications with backend systems and services using .NET, OLE DB, and other enterprise data access technologies. Ensure secure, scalable, and reliable system integrations across internal and external platforms. Database Development & Data Modeling: Collaborate with database developers to support data modeling, schema design, and performance optimization. Contribute to database development tasks using Microsoft SQL Server and Oracle as required. Agile Development & Cross-Team Collaboration: Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, including sprint planning, stand-ups, reviews, and retrospectives. Manage development activities using Team Foundation Server (TFS), Azure DevOps, or other enterprise project management tools. Collaborate with cross-functional teams across Marketing and IT— including Project Management, Business Analysts, QA, DevOps, Infrastructure, Security, and Database Administration—as well as onsite and offshore resources to ensure successful solution delivery, alignment with business objectives, and ongoing operational support. Testing, Optimization & Development Standards: Perform unit testing, debugging, performance tuning, and code refactoring to ensure high-quality and maintainable software. Adhere to organizational coding standards, documentation requirements, and secure development practices. Maintain accurate task tracking, code changes, and version control using Git or other enterprise source control systems. Platform Support & Website Maintenance: Support and enhance internal and external digital platforms, including intranet, extranet, public websites, and digital banking applications. Ensure applications meet availability, reliability, and performance standards in accordance with service level agreements (SLAs). Provide troubleshooting and technical support for application-related issues and user requests. Serve as backup administrator for Windows-based web servers when required. Security, Compliance & Documentation: Ensure compliance with organizational policies related to data protection, cybersecurity, network security, and antivirus standards. Maintain accurate service records, system documentation, configuration documentation, and knowledge base articles. Contribute to operational documentation and system runbooks supporting application environments. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or Computer Science Knowledge of financial/banking industry 3+ years of software development experience on the Microsoft technology stack. 3+ years of backend development experience using C#, .NET / .NET Core, ASP.NET MVC, Razor, and ADO.NET. 3+ years of front-end development experience building responsive and interactive user interfaces using JavaScript, jQuery, AJAX, JSON, HTML5, CSS3, and Bootstrap (or similar frameworks). Experience designing and implementing user-centric web applications, with a strong focus on usability and overall UI/UX experience. 3+ years of database development experience using T-SQL with Microsoft SQL Server. 2+ years of experience developing and consuming web services and APIs, including REST and/or SOAP using Web API or WCF. Preferred Qualifications Experience illustrating design concepts through storyboards, workflow diagrams, wireframes, and UI mockup Experience implementing complex business workflows and enterprise application logic. Knowledge of secure application development practices, including implementing security controls in .NET applications and web servers. Familiarity with modern front-end development tools Experience developing solutions using Optimizely CMS/Commerce or Digital Experience Platform (DXP). Experience with modern JavaScript frameworks such as React, Angular, or similar libraries.

Platform Support & Website Maintenance: Support and enhance internal and external digital platforms, including intranet, extranet, public websites, and digital banking applications. Experience with modern JavaScript frameworks such as React, Angular, or similar libraries.

skills.source: Software Engineer II – Full Stack Developer (Java Backend Focus) Overview We are looking for a Software Engineer with strong full-stack and backend development experience to design, build, and operate scalable, reliable, and secure software systems. In this role, you will work across the software development lifecycle, collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality solutions while leveraging modern engineering practices, cloud technologies, and automation. Responsibilities Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain scalable software applications and services. Build high-quality, secure, and reliable solutions using modern software engineering principles and best practices. Contribute to system architecture, technical design, and implementation of distributed applications and microservices. Develop and enhance RESTful APIs and backend services using Java and Spring Boot technologies. Collaborate with product managers, engineers, and stakeholders to define requirements and deliver technical solutions. Apply Agile development methodologies and participate in sprint planning, design reviews, and retrospectives. Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines to improve software delivery, quality, and deployment efficiency. Write automated tests and advocate for Test-Driven Development (TDD) and quality engineering practices. Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize applications to ensure operational stability, resiliency, and performance. Participate in code reviews and contribute to engineering standards, documentation, and knowledge sharing. skills.source: To apply, please submit a formal application through our website:  Dev10 Apply Here     Please note: Applications submitted through this job posting will not be reviewed. You must apply via our site.     Important:  This role requires willingness to relocate anywhere in the United States.     Are you ready to break into the tech industry or take your technical skills to the next level? Dev10 provides a path for individuals who have a foundation in technical skills or professional experience and are eager to continue growing.  Whether you’ve earned a technical degree, gained hands-on programming experience, or worked professionally in industries like finance, healthcare, or insurance –Dev10 is your opportunity to upskill and launch a career in Software Development.     Dev10 provides a pathway for motivated learners to gain real-world experience while developing technical skills through immersive training. Whether you're growing your existing programming knowledge or starting to build those skills for the first time, Dev10 equips you with the tools to succeed. You'll train in technologies including Java, IntelliJ, MySQL, Spring, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, REST, and React.     Now hiring for our  Software Developer  cohort startingin  January   2027.   To apply, please submit a formal application through our website:  Dev10 Apply Here       What We Require       Willingness to relocate anywhere in the continental United States   Dev10 cannot provide or support any type of employment visa or work authorization paperwork, including OPT, CPT, EAD, H-1B, or TN. The only exceptions are for Asylees, Refugees, and TPS.   Bachelor's degree   Programming experience (6+ months) shown on your resume from academic coursework, personal projects, or professional work. You must have programmed within the last 3 months.   Plus one of the following, clearly listed on your resume:     A recent STEM degree (e.g., Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline)   OR 12+ months of professional work experience in finance, healthcare, banking, insurance, hospitality, aviation, or tech, with no more than a 12-month gap since you last held that professional role         What We Look For       Passion for learning and interest in Software Development    Strong logic and reasoning skills    Clear communication and collaboration abilities    Team-oriented mindset        What We Offer       Paid training (3-4 months) to build technical skills needed from the ground up – $600/week    Mentorship and instruction from Senior Engineers in an immersive, hands-on environment    $2,500 relocation assistance    Two years of client project experience    Hourly pay rate of $24.04 (~$50k annually) or $28.85 (~$60k annually) depending on assigned location    Dev10 Manager to help you navigate corporate culture and support your growth    Comprehensive benefits: health, vision, dental, 401(k), and paid time off        Curious if a career in Software Development is right for you?   Let’s explore this career path together!     To apply, please submit a formal application through our website:  Dev10 Apply Here     Please note: Applications submitted through this job posting will not be reviewed. You must apply via our site.       For more information on Dev10, check out our website at http://www.dev-10.com/    #LI-TH1

Below is a breakdown of the essential technologies and tools that form the tech stack for a Java Full Stack Developer:     Required Skills   Back-End Technologies   •Java Programming : Core Java concepts like object-oriented programming, multithreading, and collections are fundamental.   •Spring Framework:  A powerful framework for building enterprise-level applications, including Spring Boot for microservices and RESTful APIs.   •Microservices:  For creating APIs that enable communication between client and server.  Database Management   •SQL Databases:  Proficiency in databases like MySQL, PostgreSQL, or Oracle for structured data storage.     Front-End Technologies   •HTML and CSS:  For structuring and styling web pages, ensuring responsive and visually appealing designs.   •JavaScript:  Adds interactivity and dynamic behavior to web pages. Frameworks like React, Angular are often used for building modern user interfaces.   •Accessibility Standards:  Ensures web applications are usable by individuals with disabilities, promoting inclusivity.  Development Tools   •Integrated Development Environments (IDEs):  Tools like Eclipse, IntelliJ IDEA, or NetBeans for efficient coding and debugging.  •Version Control Systems: Tools like Git and platforms like GitHub or GitLab for managing code changes and collaboration.   •Build Tools:  Tools like Maven or Gradle for project management and dependency resolution.     Deployment and DevOps   •Docker and Kubernetes:  For containerization and orchestration of applications.   •Jenkins:  For continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD).   •Cloud Platforms:  Familiarity with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform for scalable application hosting.     Testing and Debugging   •JUnit:  A unit testing framework for Java applications.   •Debugging Tools:  Proficiency in identifying and resolving code issues using breakpoints and runtime analysis.     Additional Skills   •Web Security:  Knowledge of security protocols like OAuth, JWT, and API security best practices.   •Caching:  Techniques using tools like Redis to improve application performance.  •Design Patterns: Understanding reusable solutions like dependency injection and factory patterns for efficient software design.   •Client Co-Pilot :  Knowledge in create/modify project project and able to handle mode and models     Soft Skills and Collaboration   •Teamwork and Communication:  Essential for collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.   •Agile Methodologies:  Experience with frameworks like Scrum or Kanban for iterative development.  By mastering this tech stack, a Java Full Stack Developer can build end-to-end applications that are efficient, secure, and user-friendly, meeting both client and business requirements.     Company Benefits & Culture  •    Inclusive and diverse work environment  •    Opportunities for professional growth and development  •    Comprehensive health and wellness benefits

skills.label: Java
skills.source: Ampcus Inc. is a certified global provider of a broad range of Technology and Business consulting services. We are in search of a highly motivated candidate to join our talented Team.      Job Title:  Backend Developer   Location(s):  Pleasanton, CA.       Core Responsibilities:     Design, build, optimize, and maintain scalable, resilient, and high-performance backend systems using Java, Kotlin, and other JVM-based technologies.   Develop, enhance, and maintain RESTful APIs with strong adherence to security, performance, and reliability standards.   Implement services using Spring Boot, Quarkus, and modern web technologies, following 12-factor app principles for cloud-native development.   Integrate and manage event-driven architecture using Apache Kafka or RabbitMQ.   Work with PostgreSQL and MongoDB databases, ensuring efficient schema design, performance optimization, and reliability.   Utilize Git, GitHub, and GitHub Actions for version control, CI/CD automation, and deployment pipelines.   Build and deploy containerized applications using Docker and orchestrate them on Kubernetes platforms (AKS, GKE, or equivalent).   Collaborate cross-functionally within Agile/SCRUM teams, contributing to sprint planning, estimation, and delivery.   Ensure adherence to secure coding practices, SDLC standards, and compliance frameworks.   Monitor and enhance system performance using alerting and observability tools such as Nagios, New Relic, Splunk, or GCP monitoring.   Work with public cloud platforms (Azure or OCI) for application deployment, scaling, and operational readiness.   If required, contribute to Salesforce Development (SFDC) and Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) or other platforms such as Shopify, SFCC, Stibo, or SFSC.     Required Skills and Qualifications:     Strong proficiency in Java, Kotlin, JVM-based development, Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), and robust exception-handling practices.   Hands-on experience with Spring Boot, Quarkus, and modern backend web technologies.   Expertise in event-streaming and messaging platforms such as Apache Kafka and/or RabbitMQ.   Solid experience developing and maintaining REST APIs and microservices architectures.   Proficiency with front-end technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) as required.   Strong understanding of Git, GitHub, GitHub Actions, and other DevOps tools (Chef, Jenkins, Puppet, ArgoCD).   Practical experience working with relational and NoSQL databases, especially PostgreSQL and MongoDB.   Working knowledge of containerization (Docker) and Kubernetes orchestration (AKS, GKE).   Understanding of public cloud platforms including Azure and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).   Experience with monitoring, logging, and alerting tools (Nagios, New Relic, Splunk, GCP Monitoring).   Familiarity with 12-factor app methodology and modern cloud-native design principles.   Knowledge of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), Agile/SCRUM methods, and industry best practices.           Ampcus is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veterans or individuals with disabilities.

evidence.text: Delivered Fortune 500 Java systems for Fidelity, British Telecom and T-Mobile over 3 years spanning secure insurance exchange, telecom commerce and an AWS operations platform for 3K employees.

skills.label: API
skills.source: Ampcus Inc. is a certified global provider of a broad range of Technology and Business consulting services. We are in search of a highly motivated candidate to join our talented Team.       Job Title:  Software Dev Engineer I.   Location:  Seattle, WA.         Job Description:     Client Payment Products team is looking for developers to design and build next generation global payments solutions that revolutionize the way customers pay. The Client Payments Team manages all Client branded payment offerings, globally.    These offerings are growing rapidly and we are continuously adding new market-leading features and launching new products. Our payments products (Client Co-Branded Credit Cards, Private Labeled Credit Cards, Non-Client Branded Credit Cards, Shop with Points and Foreign Exchange) provide the most innovative payment experience on and off Client.   As we build innovative payments solutions for our customers, the role provides a huge opportunity for the developers to build a strong portfolio of patents for Client. The role will also include defining and implementing extensible, multi-faceted solutions that support global and region specific payments specific protocols and workflows. This is a critical program for Consumer Payments, with high leadership visibility, and opportunity for delivering significant business value.   We are looking for passionate, experienced software developers that can lead a team of developers in delivering high quality software solutions to support variety of customer use cases and are scalable to handle Client volume.   Developers in the team need a strong understanding of Computer fundamentals and practical experience in building full stack, large scale distributed systems. Experience with web-based applications and/or web services-based applications, especially at massive scale, is also helpful.     Key job responsibilities:     Develop and maintain backend services.   Create and optimize rendering solutions for multiple channels.   Design and develop APIs for system integration.   Write clean, maintainable code following best practices.   Implement monitoring and alerting mechanisms.   Optimize system performance for high-traffic applications.   Contribute to continuous improvement of development practices.                       Ampcus is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veterans or individuals with disabilities.

skills.source: Request ID: 108983-1  Title: Full-stack developer - Python  Locations: Onsite: Sunnyvale, CA (Onsite)  Duration: 6 Months  Pay rate: $50-$58/hr on W2/C2C     Job Summary  Digital : Python; FastAPI; Django; flask; Pytest; system designRESTful APIs; SQL Server    We are seeking a talented and motivated Python Backend Developer to design, build, and maintain our high-performance cloud applications. In this role, you will focus on building robust server-side logic, developing secure APIs, and managing data persistence layers. You will collaborate closely with frontend engineers, product managers, and DevOps teams to deliver scalable microservices that power our core business platforms.  ________________________________________  Key Responsibilities  •System Design: Architect and scale distributed backend systems that handle high traffic, concurrency, and data throughput.  •API Development: Design, develop, and maintain high-throughput, secure RESTful APIs and microservices.  •Database Management: Optimize database schemas, write complex SQL queries, and manage data persistence using ORM frameworks.  •Security & Auth: Implement and maintain robust security protocols for authentication and authorization.  •Testing Automation: Write comprehensive unit, integration, and regression test suites to ensure high code quality.  •CI/CD & Cloud: Package applications into containers and assist in deploying services to cloud infrastructure.  •Performance Tuning: Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize application performance, memory leaks, and query bottlenecks.  ________________________________________  Required Skills & Qualifications  •System Design: Proven experience with distributed systems design, load balancing, caching strategies, and system scalability.  •Data Structures & Algorithms: Strong foundational knowledge of data structures (trees, graphs, hash maps) and algorithms to write highly efficient code.  •Core Python: Deep knowledge of Python 3.10+, handling async programming (asyncio), and memory management.  •Python Ecosystem: Hands-on experience with modern web frameworks like FastAPI, Django, or Flask.  •Databases: Strong proficiency in relational databases (SQLserver, PostgreSQL, MySQL) and ORM/ODM tools (SQLAlchemy, Django ORM).  •API Design: Proven experience designing clean RESTful web services and integrating with third-party systems.  •Build & Test Tools: Daily experience using dependency managers like Poetry or Pipenv, alongside testing tools like Pytest and unittest.  •Version Control: Mastery of Git for branching, merging, and pull requests."    Company Benefits & Culture   •    Inclusive and diverse work environment  •    Opportunities for professional growth and development  •    Comprehensive health and wellness benefits

Role Details   Location: Remote   Type: Fulltime   Key Responsibilities     Develop responsive frontend applications using ReactJS (Hooks, state management) to support backend-driven features. Must-Have Skills     AI / Agentic AI / MCP: Solid understanding of LLM fundamentals, agentic AI architectures (planning, tool use, multi-step workflows), and the Model Context Protocol (MCP) for agent–system integration; familiarity with frameworks such as LangChain / LangGraph is a strong plus.   Python Backend (Primary): Strong, hands-on experience building backend services with FastAPI / Flask / Django — async patterns, dependency injection, middleware, API versioning, testing, and production deployment.   Databases: Deep practical experience with PostgreSQL / MySQL / SQL Server — complex queries, joins, indexing, transactions, ORM usage (SQLAlchemy / Django ORM), and performance tuning.   Authentication & Security: Demonstrated depth in auth frameworks beyond JWT basics — OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SSO, RBAC, secure session handling, and API security best practices.   RESTful APIs: Proven experience designing, building, and integrating REST APIs and backend services at scale.   ReactJS (Secondary): Hands-on expertise with ReactJS — Hooks, component lifecycle, and state management (Redux / Context API).     Ampcus is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are in search of a highly motivated candidate to join our talented Team.      Job Title:  Software Engineering - Core Java – Intermediate.   Duration:  Chicago, IL.         Job Description:     Develop and maintain applications using Apache Spark and Java.   Work with different aspects of Spark ecosystem including Datasets, Spark SQL, and Scalability support.   Work with business analysts and lead engineers to understand requirements and designs for implementing software solutions.   Work on performance improvement activities to support Spark applications to process millions of data elements every day.   Production support and troubleshooting activities to uncover issues in the Spark applications.   Contributes to software engineering communities of practice and events that explore new and emerging technologies.   Adds to team culture of diversity, equity, inclusion, and respect. Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills:     Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 3 years’ applied experience.   Work experience in Data Engineering domain.   Hands-on practical experience in system design (simple), application development, testing, and operational stability.   Proficient in coding in one or more languages including Java.   Experience in developing, debugging, and maintaining code in a corporate environment with Java, Spark Framework, and Database querying languages (any SQL usage experience).   Overall knowledge of the Software Development Life Cycle.   Experience working in an Agile Software Development Environment.     Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills:     Exposure to cloud technologies such as AWS, Kubernetes, and Kafka.                   Ampcus is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veterans, or individuals with disabilities.

skills.label: Python
skills.source: Ampcus Inc. is a certified global provider of a broad range of Technology and Business consulting services. We are in search of a highly motivated candidate to join our talented Team.     Job Title:  Python Full Stack Developer   Location:  McLean, VA        Job Description:  We are looking for a passionate Python Full Stack Developer to join our team. You will be responsible for developing and implementing high-quality software solutions, creating complex applications using cutting-edge programming features and frameworks, and collaborating with other teams in the firm to define, design, and ship new features.  As an active part of our company, you will brainstorm and chalk out solutions to suit our requirements and meet our business goals. You will also be working on data engineering problems and building data pipelines. You would get ample opportunities to work on challenging and innovative projects, using the latest technologies and tools.      Key Responsibilities:     Develop, test and maintain high-quality software using Python programming language.   Participate in the entire software development lifecycle, building, testing and delivering high-quality solutions.   Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify and solve complex problems.   Write clean and reusable code that can be easily maintained and scaled.   Create large-scale data processing pipelines to help developers build and train Client machine learning algorithms.   Participate in code reviews, ensure code quality and identify areas for improvement to implement practical solutions.   Debugging codes when required and troubleshooting any Python-related queries.   Keep up to date with emerging trends and technologies in Python development.         Required Skills and Qualifications:     Python (MUST).   AWS Airflow, Lambda, Kinesis, SQS and DynamoDB (NEEDED).   Javascript (great to have).   Snowflake (nice to have on the database front).   3 years of experience as a Python Developer with a strong portfolio of projects.   Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field.   In-depth understanding of the Python software development stacks, ecosystems, frameworks and tools such as Numpy, Scipy, Pandas, Dask, spaCy, NLTK, sci-kit-learn and PyTorch.   Excellent problem-solving ability with solid communication and collaboration skills.         Preferred Skills and Qualifications:     Experience with popular Python frameworks such as Django, Flask or Pyramid.   Knowledge of data science and machine learning concepts and tools.   Contributions to open-source Python projects or active involvement in the Python community.           Ampcus is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veterans or individuals with disabilities.

skills.source: Ampcus Inc. is a certified global provider of a broad range of Technology and Business consulting services. We are in search of a highly motivated candidate to join our talented Team.       Job Title: Software Engineer - II/ .Net Developer   Location:  Atlanta, GA 30326 or Oklahoma City, OK 73132, or Cincinnati, OH 45249 – 3 days onsite   Duration:  9 months assignment with the possibility of extension   Job Description:    Client, a leader in payment technology, is seeking an experienced  Software Engineer II  to join our Paymetric Engineering team. In this role, you will be a key contributor to the development of highly transactional, cloud-based microservices and solutions, with a strong emphasis on tokenization and encryption for the payments/fintech industry.   This is an excellent opportunity for a motivated self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced, agile environment and enjoys collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software solutions.   Responsibilities:     Design, develop, and maintain backend services using .NET and .NET Core, with a focus on high-transaction payment platforms.   Build and optimize cloud-based microservices in AWS, ensuring scalability, reliability, and security.   Work closely with engineering leads and managers to articulate and implement solutions for complex problems, including the ability to write and explain pseudocode.   Troubleshoot and resolve issues across the software development lifecycle using Agile methodologies.   Contribute to the ongoing improvement of engineering processes and best practices within the team.   Participate in code reviews and collaborate with team members to deliver robust, maintainable software solutions.     Required Qualifications:     3-5 years of software engineering experience, including at least 2 years in FINTECH or payments platforms.   Proficiency in .NET and .NET Core. We are in search of a highly motivated candidate to join our talented Team.      Job Title:  Python Developer     Location(s):  Richmond, VA       Job Description:     We are looking for a passionate Python Developer to join our team.   You will be responsible for developing and implementing high-quality software solutions, creating complex applications using cutting-edge programming features and frameworks and collaborating with other teams in the firm to define, design and ship new features.   As an active part of our company, you will brainstorm and chalk out solutions to suit our requirements and meet our business goals. You will also be working on data engineering problems and building data pipelines. You would get ample opportunities to work on challenging and innovative projects, using the latest technologies and tools.   If you enjoy working in a fast-paced and collaborative environment, we encourage you to apply for this exciting role. We offer industry-standard compensation packages, relocation assistance, and professional growth and development opportunities.     Objectives of this role     Develop, test and maintain high-quality software using Python programming language.   Participate in the entire software development lifecycle, building, testing and delivering high-quality solutions.   Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify and solve complex problems.   Write clean and reusable code that can be easily maintained and scaled.   Create large-scale data processing pipelines to help developers build and train Client machine learning algorithms.   Participate in code reviews, ensure code quality and identify areas for improvement to implement practical solutions.   Debugging codes when required and troubleshooting any Python-related queries.   Keep up to date with emerging trends and technologies in Python development.     Required skills and qualifications     3+ years of experience as a Python Developer with a strong portfolio of projects.   Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field.   Strong expertise with Python, AWS, Stepfunctions, Lambda.   In-depth understanding of the Python software development stacks, ecosystems, frameworks and tools such as Numpy, Scipy, Pandas, Dask, spaCy, NLTK, sci-kit-learn and PyTorch.   Experience with front-end development using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.   Familiarity with database technologies such as SQL and NoSQL.   Excellent problem-solving ability with solid communication and collaboration skills.     Preferred skills and qualifications     Experience with popular Python frameworks such as Django, Flask or Pyramid.   Knowledge of data science and machine learning concepts and tools.   Contributions to open-source Python projects or active involvement in the Python community.         Ampcus is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veterans or individuals with disabilities.

We are in search of a highly motivated candidate to join our talented Team.      Job Title:  Python Developer     Location(s):  Richmond, VA       Job Description:     We are looking for a passionate Python Developer to join our team.   You will be responsible for developing and implementing high-quality software solutions, creating complex applications using cutting-edge programming features and frameworks and collaborating with other teams in the firm to define, design and ship new features.   As an active part of our company, you will brainstorm and chalk out solutions to suit our requirements and meet our business goals. You will also be working on data engineering problems and building data pipelines. You would get ample opportunities to work on challenging and innovative projects, using the latest technologies and tools.   If you enjoy working in a fast-paced and collaborative environment, we encourage you to apply for this exciting role. We offer industry-standard compensation packages, relocation assistance, and professional growth and development opportunities.     Objectives of this role     Develop, test and maintain high-quality software using Python programming language.   Participate in the entire software development lifecycle, building, testing and delivering high-quality solutions.   Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify and solve complex problems.   Write clean and reusable code that can be easily maintained and scaled.   Create large-scale data processing pipelines to help developers build and train Client machine learning algorithms.   Participate in code reviews, ensure code quality and identify areas for improvement to implement practical solutions.   Debugging codes when required and troubleshooting any Python-related queries.   Keep up to date with emerging trends and technologies in Python development.     Required skills and qualifications     3+ years of experience as a Python Developer with a strong portfolio of projects.   Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field.   Strong expertise with Python, AWS, Stepfunctions, Lambda.   In-depth understanding of the Python software development stacks, ecosystems, frameworks and tools such as Numpy, Scipy, Pandas, Dask, spaCy, NLTK, sci-kit-learn and PyTorch.   Experience with front-end development using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.   Familiarity with database technologies such as SQL and NoSQL.   Excellent problem-solving ability with solid communication and collaboration skills.     Preferred skills and qualifications     Experience with popular Python frameworks such as Django, Flask or Pyramid.   Knowledge of data science and machine learning concepts and tools.   Contributions to open-source Python projects or active involvement in the Python community.         Ampcus is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veterans or individuals with disabilities.

skills.label: Python / JavaScript
skills.source: Strong programming skills in Python and JavaScript, with solid experience in at least one of: Java, PowerShell, or C#; comfortable switching across languages and technology stacks to contribute to multiple active projects simultaneously. Hands-on experience developing automation and security workflows, dedicating a significant portion of time to building software and integrations for data protection initiatives. Strong experience with Endpoint. Proficiency in scripting and automation using Python and PowerShell for task automation, system administration, security operations workflows, and integration with enterprise platforms (e.g., Active Directory, Microsoft 365, Azure). Manage DLP tools, including configuring policies, tuning, testing, and implementing new features and functionality. Provide support across multiple areas of data security and operations: Data Loss Prevention (DLP), data minimization, data discovery, cloud data protection, Privileged Access Management (PAM), data privacy, data labeling, data classification and rights management, data encryption, and data access governance. Manage the technical configuration, implementation, administration, and support of multiple data security products and solutions such as CASB, SASE, DLP, and DSPM. Develop technical documentation (e.g., system designs, architecture diagrams, data flows, functional specifications). Leverage APIs to collect key performance indicators (KPIs) and key risk indicators (KRIs) for data governance and protection controls. Collaborate with senior leadership and cross-functional teams including Security Operations, Legal, Privacy, Data and Analytics, Enterprise Architecture, Platform teams, and sector functions. Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and containerization technologies (e.g., Docker) to deploy and operate security and data protection solutions. Familiarity with version control systems (e.g., Git), CI/CD pipelines, and automation tools to accelerate delivery and maintenance of security capabilities. Experience using data analytics and visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Looker, QuickSight) to create dashboards and insights for KPIs and KRIs related to data security. Ability to analyze security telemetry and operational data to generate actionable insights that drive program decisions and risk mitigation strategies. Solid background and understanding of security concepts such as data classification, data loss prevention (DLP) strategies , data discovery, data masking, rights management, data residency, cloud data protection, and regulatory compliance frameworks (e.g., GDPR, CCPA, PCI-DSS). 3+ years in data security, data loss prevention (DLP), software development, or computer engineering; or master's degree in computer science/engineering or related data security field, and 1 year of relevant experience.

evidence.text: Interviewed 500+ engineering candidates over 3 years with a standardized technical program and scoring rubrics for Java, Python and cloud teams.

skills.label: Python
skills.source: Location: Chicago, IL - need local candidates only   Salary Range: 40-45/hr on W2   Introduction   Client is seeking Software Engineers to join its enterprise CI/CD and Developer Tooling organization. The team is responsible for managing and supporting CI/CD tooling used by engineering teams across the enterprise. This is a backend-focused software engineering and platform engineering role involving development, automation, cloud infrastructure tooling, CI/CD pipelines, troubleshooting, and internal developer support.   Required Skills & Qualifications     Strong hands-on experience with  Python  development or automation.   Experience with  AWS CDK .   Experience with  Boto3  or AWS SDKs.   Hands-on Jenkins administration or operational management experience.   Experience with  Groovy  and Jenkins Pipeline.   Experience with  TypeScript .   Experience with  Java or Go .   Experience with  Docker  and containerized applications.   Experience with  Amazon ECS .   Experience with  AWS Lambda, DynamoDB, and Fargate .   Experience with  Terraform  or other Infrastructure as Code tools.   Experience supporting enterprise developer platforms or internal engineering tools.   Experience with vulnerability management, compliance requirements, and software/platform upgrades.   Experience working with  AWS  cloud services.   Hands-on experience with  Infrastructure as Code (IaC) .   Strong understanding of  CI/CD concepts and deployment pipelines .   Experience with  Jenkins .   Experience developing or supporting backend applications, automation tools, or developer platforms.   Strong troubleshooting and debugging skills.   Ability to work across multiple technologies and learn new tools quickly.   Strong communication and collaboration skills.   Must have previous client experience working for this customer in the past 5 years.     Preferred Skills & Qualifications     Experience with vulnerability management, compliance requirements, and software/platform upgrades.   Experience working with  AWS  cloud services.   Hands-on experience with  Infrastructure as Code (IaC) .     Day-to-Day Responsibilities     Design, develop, enhance, and maintain software components supporting enterprise CI/CD platforms.   Develop automation and backend tooling primarily using  Python .   Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using  Jenkins  and related technologies.   Troubleshoot pipeline failures, deployment issues, automation problems, and platform-related incidents.   Work with  AWS  services and cloud automation frameworks.   Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code solutions for standardized infrastructure provisioning.   Work extensively with  AWS CDK  and AWS SDKs such as  Boto3 .   Support and maintain Jenkins environments, including pipeline configuration, troubleshooting, and operational maintenance.   Develop Jenkins pipelines and automation using  Groovy  where required.   Work with container technologies such as  Docker and Amazon ECS .   Support AWS services including  Lambda, DynamoDB, and Fargate .   Address vulnerabilities, security requirements, compliance-related upgrades, and platform maintenance activities.   Investigate issues reported by internal engineering teams and provide technical solutions or workarounds.   Identify and fix bugs within internal developer tools and automation platforms.   Collaborate with software engineers, platform engineers, DevOps teams, and other technology groups.   Participate in rotating assignments involving customer support, debugging, platform development, and maintenance.   Document technical solutions and contribute to continuous improvement of enterprise developer tooling.     Company Benefits & Culture     Comprehensive health and wellness benefits.   Opportunities for career advancement and professional development.   Inclusive and collaborative work environment.     For immediate consideration please click APPLY to begin the screening process with Alex.

skills.source: Job Summary The Data Scientist will analyze large, complex operational datasets to develop statistical insights, machine learning solutions, and executive-ready dashboards that support business and product decisions. The role requires strong proficiency in Python, SQL Server, Oracle, Tableau, Splunk, statistical inference, and machine learning fundamentals. The candidate will translate ambiguous business requirements into actionable data problems, build production-quality data pipelines and dashboards, monitor deployed solutions for performance issues and data drift, and communicate findings effectively to Product Owners, VPs, and other stakeholders. Key Responsibilities •    Analyze large and complex operational datasets using Python, SQL, and statistical methods to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights. •    Develop data analysis and machine learning solutions using Python libraries such as pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, and at least one of statsmodels, TensorFlow, or PyTorch. •    Apply statistical inference and hypothesis testing to investigate business and operational questions. •    Develop and evaluate machine learning models for classification, regression, clustering, and tree-based modeling. •    Query and analyze data from SQL Server and Oracle databases, with exposure to Snowflake where applicable. •    Build, optimize, and maintain Tableau dashboards that are user-friendly, performant, and suitable for executive audiences. •    Develop Splunk SPL searches and dashboards using operational data. •    Build and maintain production-quality data pipelines, dashboards, and reusable code rather than one-off scripts. •    Use Git/GitLab for version control and maintain well-documented, maintainable code. •    Monitor deployed pipelines, dashboards, and models to identify data drift, performance issues, and operational problems. •    Translate ambiguous business requests into clearly defined, actionable data problems and deliver practical solutions independently. •    Present findings, recommendations, and technical insights to non-technical stakeholders, Product Owners, and VP-level audiences. Required Qualifications •    Strong proficiency in Python, including pandas, NumPy, and scikit-learn, plus experience with at least one of statsmodels, TensorFlow, or PyTorch. •    Experience working with SQL Server and Oracle; Snowflake experience is an advantage. •    Experience developing and optimizing Tableau dashboards for usability, performance, and executive reporting. •    Experience with Splunk SPL searches and dashboard development using operational data. •    Strong understanding of statistical inference and hypothesis testing on large, complex operational datasets. •    Knowledge of machine learning fundamentals, including classification, regression, clustering, and tree-based models. •    Experience with Git/GitLab version control and writing maintainable, documented code. •    Strong communication skills and the ability to present findings to technical and non-technical stakeholders, including senior leadership. •    Ability to work independently, clarify ambiguous business requirements, and deliver production-quality data solutions. Preferred Qualifications •    Experience in telecommunications, cable, or call center operations. •    Knowledge of natural language processing (NLP), including transformers, Hugging Face, topic modeling, embeddings, or semantic search. •    Experience with MLOps tools and practices, including Prefect, Airflow, Docker, or GitLab CI/CD. •    Experience with time-series analysis involving high-volume event data. •    Familiarity with vector databases such as ChromaDB, Pinecone, or FAISS. •    Experience with Alteryx, including migration of workflows to Python, or tools such as Streamlit. •    Experience with REST APIs for platforms such as Jira, Tableau, or Splunk. •    Familiarity with cloud data platforms such as Google Cloud Storage (GCS), AWS, or Azure. •    Experience with Snowflake.

skills.source: Role: Full Stack Engineer Level II  Location: Plano, TX (Preferred); McLean, VA and Richmond, VA are also considered  Contract: 12 Months        Position Overview  Capital One is seeking a hands-on Full Stack Software Engineer to join its Core division's engineering team, which focuses on reducing operational toil by building innovative internal applications, automation solutions, and tools that improve engineering productivity.  This is a fast-paced, backend-focused engineering role requiring strong Python development skills, experience with REST APIs, SQL, AWS, CI/CD, and practical use of AI-assisted development tools. The engineer will work on internal notification and remediation solutions, identify technical problems, develop solutions, and deliver production-ready code quickly.  The ideal candidate is self-driven, adaptable, comfortable working with minimal supervision, and capable of taking ownership of tasks from problem definition through development, testing, deployment, and support.   Key Responsibilities     Design, develop, test, and maintain backend services and REST APIs using Python.   Build and enhance internal engineering tools, notification applications, and automated remediation solutions.   Develop and maintain SQL schemas, datasets, and data pipelines as required by project needs.   Leverage AWS services to develop and support scalable cloud-based applications.   Use AI-assisted coding tools and agentic AI solutions to accelerate development, troubleshoot issues, and improve engineering productivity.   Work with existing MCP servers and integrate available AI capabilities into internal applications and workflows.   Contribute to frontend development using React, with frontend work accounting for a smaller portion of the overall workload.   Implement CI/CD processes and address application vulnerabilities, security findings, and compliance requirements.   Troubleshoot application issues, analyze logs, support production systems, and resolve technical problems independently.   Create and maintain observability dashboards using tools such as Splunk, New Relic, or similar monitoring platforms.   Participate in Agile/Kanban ceremonies, daily stand-ups, Jira story tracking, quarterly planning activities, and technical demonstrations.   Collaborate with team members, communicate progress clearly, and provide technical support to unblock others when needed.   Work effectively in a dynamic environment where requirements may evolve and solutions need to be delivered within days or weeks.     Required Skills and Qualifications     Strong hands-on experience in  Python backend development .   Experience designing and developing REST APIs and backend services.   Working knowledge of  React or similar frontend technologies  and the ability to contribute to frontend development.   Experience with SQL, database schemas, data modeling, and data pipeline development.   Hands-on experience with AWS cloud services and familiarity with cloud architecture and terminology.   Experience with CI/CD pipelines, automation, troubleshooting, and software deployment.   Practical experience using AI-powered development tools, such as Claude Code or comparable AI coding assistants.   Understanding of agentic AI development, AI-powered automation, or integration with existing MCP servers is highly desirable.   Experience with application vulnerability remediation, security findings, and compliance-related engineering tasks.   Familiarity with observability tools such as Splunk, New Relic, or similar platforms.   Experience analyzing application logs and resolving production issues.   Previous experience working with Capital One or similar large enterprise engineering environments.   Strong problem-solving skills, adaptability, communication skills, and the ability to work independently with minimal supervision.   Experience building AI-powered developer productivity tools or agentic AI solutions.     Preferred Qualifications     Familiarity with MCP server integrations and leveraging existing MCP capabilities within applications.   Experience working with Go or maintaining Java-based legacy applications.   Experience building internal engineering tools, notification systems, automated remediation solutions, and operational automation.   Strong presentation skills and the ability to demonstrate completed solutions to technical stakeholders.     Expected Work Distribution     50% – Backend APIs and data:  REST API development, database schemas, datasets, and related data processing.   25% – Security and compliance:  Vulnerability remediation, compliance findings, and related engineering activities.   25% – Frontend and other engineering tasks:  React development, troubleshooting, legacy application maintenance, and production support.    The role is primarily backend-focused. Python is the main development language; Java is being phased out, with any remaining Java work largely limited to maintenance and bug fixes.   Team and Work Environment  The engineer will join a small, collaborative team of approximately 6–8 people. Team members typically own individual tasks but are expected to collaborate, learn quickly, and support colleagues when priorities change.  The team follows a Kanban-based workflow using Jira and conducts regular stand-ups, quarterly planning, and technical demonstrations. Engineers are expected to work with limited documentation, clarify problem statements, iterate quickly, obtain team feedback, and deliver solutions with minimal supervision.  Some production support and monitoring responsibilities may be required, including reviewing logs and resolving issues during the approximate 7:00 a.m.–9:00 p.m. support window. This does not imply continuous overnight on-call coverage.

evidence.text: Interviewed 500+ engineering candidates over 3 years with a standardized technical program and scoring rubrics for Java, Python and cloud teams.

skills.source: Request ID: 109156-1  Title: AI-Native Software Engineer  Location: San Jose CA or Raleigh NC (onsite)  Duration: 6 months  Pay Range: $45 - $50/Hour on W2/C2C (All inclusive)    JOB DESCRIPTION:      Responsibilities:  You have proven experience serving as a software engineer for web application projects, hosted On-Prem and Cloud, supporting a large customer base.  You know when to build and when to reach for a managed AWS service you can justify that trade-off based on the problem.  You think in systems and evaluate designs critically whether reviewing AI-generated code or your own architecture catching the subtle bug, security gap, or design choice that won't hold up under load or misuse.  You use spec-driven development with AI as your default way of engineering software.  You treat performance as a design constraint, not a tuning pass after the fact.  You pick up new tools and approaches quickly, since the effective way to work with AI changes often, and you'd rather adapt early than fall behind.  You are decisive without being divisive you can analytically weigh trade-offs, balance competing priorities, and drive decisions that span organizational boundaries.  You have excellent communication and organization skills.      Minimum Qualifications:  BS or MS degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field, or demonstrated equivalent experience.  Demonstrated fluency in leveraging AI technologies across the entire software development lifecycle, including breaking down user stories into actionable tasks, AI-assisted coding and  testing, automated defect resolution, and deployment of fully tested software.  Deep, hands-on experience building and deploying production systems on AWS (e.g., EC2, Lambda, ECS/EKS, S3, RDS/DynamoDB, API Gateway), with a record of real, customer-facing applications running in production.  Server-side software development experience with Python, Java, NodeJS, and/or other similar technologies; client-side web application development experience using React, Backbone, native JavaScript, and/or other comparable technologies.  Expertise in building secure, large-scale systems using fault-tolerant technologies (such as Elasticsearch, CockroachDB, Oracle, MongoDB & Kafka).  AWS certification (e.g., Solutions Architect, Developer) and/or CISSP/CCSP or similar security certification useful, not required.        Company Benefits & Culture  Opportunity to work with a dynamic team in a fast-paced environment  Exposure to cutting-edge technologies and methodologies  Supportive and collaborative work culture      Appreciate your quick response and please feel free to reach me out for any query you may have.      Thanks

skills.source: Request ID: 109156-1  Title: AI-Native Software Engineer  Location: San Jose CA or Raleigh NC (onsite)  Duration: 6 months  Pay Range: $45 - $50/Hour on W2/C2C (All inclusive)    JOB DESCRIPTION:      Responsibilities:  You have proven experience serving as a software engineer for web application projects, hosted On-Prem and Cloud, supporting a large customer base.  You know when to build and when to reach for a managed AWS service you can justify that trade-off based on the problem.  You think in systems and evaluate designs critically whether reviewing AI-generated code or your own architecture catching the subtle bug, security gap, or design choice that won't hold up under load or misuse.  You use spec-driven development with AI as your default way of engineering software.  You treat performance as a design constraint, not a tuning pass after the fact.  You pick up new tools and approaches quickly, since the effective way to work with AI changes often, and you'd rather adapt early than fall behind.  You are decisive without being divisive you can analytically weigh trade-offs, balance competing priorities, and drive decisions that span organizational boundaries.  You have excellent communication and organization skills.      Minimum Qualifications:  BS or MS degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field, or demonstrated equivalent experience.  Demonstrated fluency in leveraging AI technologies across the entire software development lifecycle, including breaking down user stories into actionable tasks, AI-assisted coding and  testing, automated defect resolution, and deployment of fully tested software.  Deep, hands-on experience building and deploying production systems on AWS (e.g., EC2, Lambda, ECS/EKS, S3, RDS/DynamoDB, API Gateway), with a record of real, customer-facing applications running in production.  Server-side software development experience with Python, Java, NodeJS, and/or other similar technologies; client-side web application development experience using React, Backbone, native JavaScript, and/or other comparable technologies.  Expertise in building secure, large-scale systems using fault-tolerant technologies (such as Elasticsearch, CockroachDB, Oracle, MongoDB & Kafka).  AWS certification (e.g., Solutions Architect, Developer) and/or CISSP/CCSP or similar security certification useful, not required.        Company Benefits & Culture  Opportunity to work with a dynamic team in a fast-paced environment  Exposure to cutting-edge technologies and methodologies  Supportive and collaborative work culture      Appreciate your quick response and please feel free to reach me out for any query you may have.      Thanks

skills.source: job summary:   Hiring for a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world's money. Min fees. Max ease. Full speed. Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money. As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money. For everyone, everywhere.        location: Austin, Texas   job type: Permanent   salary: $120,000 - 150,000  per year   work hours: 9am to 5pm   education: Bachelors       responsibilities:   Key Responsibilities  Build and maintain:  Develop the services and partner integrations that power reliable USD and CAD money movement. Feature ownership:  Take end-to-end ownership of specific features and components, from understanding the problem through delivery, rollout, and long-term operation. Quality delivery:  Write maintainable, well-tested code while ensuring predictable delivery and effective observability. Team contribution:  Participate actively in code reviews, share technical knowledge, and collaborate closely with your peers to reduce knowledge silos. Product alignment:  Apply a strong product mindset to connect your daily engineering tasks to customer outcomes, payout speed, and system quality.         qualifications:   Requirements  Core stack: Solid experience building backend systems with Java or Kotlin, Spring Boot, microservices, relational databases, and well-designed APIs.  System knowledge: A working understanding of distributed systems principles, including asynchronous processing, data consistency, and failure recovery.  Working style: A self-starting and collaborative approach, with the ability to work independently on defined features and ask the right questions when blocked.  Communication: Clear communication skills, with the ability to discuss technical concepts effectively with team members and cross-functional partners.  Bonus skills: Experience with Kafka, event-driven architecture, or cloud infrastructure is highly valued, though not strictly required.      skills:   Kafka,APIs,backend,cloud infrastructure,code reviews,CAD,distributed systems,event-driven architecture,Java,Kotlin,microservices,relational databases,Spring Boot,Communication,self-starting,ability to work independently,collaborative,data consistency,product mindset,Clear communication,system quality,technical knowledge      Equal Opportunity Employer: Race, Color, Religion, Sex, Sexual Orientation, Gender Identity, National Origin, Age, Genetic Information, Disability, Protected Veteran Status, or any other legally protected group status. We are in search of a highly motivated candidate to join our talented Team.   Role Summary:   Lead design and development of full-stack features using React, Java/Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, Snowflake, Highcharts, Apache Superset, Redis caching, and RBAC.   Responsibilities:     Lead implementation of React UI components and Java/Spring Boot services.   Design APIs, service workflows, and integrations with PostgreSQL and read-only Snowflake datasets.   Implement query-time aggregation, reporting views, and dashboard integrations using Highcharts and Apache Superset.   Guide developers on Redis caching, RBAC, audit logging, code quality, and secure development practices.   Conduct code reviews, resolve technical blockers, and ensure adherence to architecture standards.     Required Skills:     6 years of full-stack development experience.   Hands-on expertise in React, Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, and secure API design.   Strong experience with PostgreSQL, Snowflake queries, and performance tuning.   Experience with Highcharts, Apache Superset, Redis caching, and RBAC.   Strong mentoring, troubleshooting, and Agile delivery skills.     Ampcus is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veterans or individuals with disabilities.

evidence.text: British Telecom REST and GraphQL APIs with Resilience4j; 10K+ daily transactions; 200ms P99; 99% uptime.

skills.source: Software & DevOps Engineer – Senior   Location:  Dallas/Irving, TX   Work Arrangement:  Hybrid – 3 days per week onsite at the client office   Contract Duration:  6+ months, with a strong possibility of extension based on performance   Job Overview   We are seeking a  Senior Software & DevOps Engineer  with strong hands-on experience in  Go (Golang), Java, JavaScript, and Python  to design, develop, secure, and maintain enterprise-level applications and platforms.   The ideal candidate will have a strong software engineering background combined with  DevSecOps, CI/CD, cloud-native development, containerization, and Secure Development Lifecycle (SDL)  experience. This individual will play a key role in strengthening software supply chain security and promoting secure development practices throughout the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC).   Experience within the  Banking, Capital Markets, or Cybersecurity  domains is highly preferred.   Key Responsibilities   Software Engineering       Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable enterprise-grade software applications using  Go, Java, JavaScript, and Python .       Develop secure, cloud-native applications using modern software engineering practices.       Design and implement  microservices, distributed systems, APIs, and scalable application architectures .       Participate in technical design discussions and contribute to architecture and technology decisions.       Conduct and participate in code reviews to ensure code quality, maintainability, performance, and security.       Evaluate and integrate appropriate open-source technologies and frameworks.       Troubleshoot complex application and production issues and implement sustainable solutions.       DevSecOps & CI/CD       Design, implement, and optimize  CI/CD pipelines  using tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or GitLab.       Integrate automated security testing and quality checks into CI/CD pipelines.       Implement automated  code scanning, vulnerability scanning, dependency analysis, and security testing .       Develop automation to support continuous integration, testing, deployment, and secure software releases.       Promote and implement

evidence.text: Interviewed 500+ engineering candidates over 3 years with a standardized technical program and scoring rubrics for Java, Python and cloud teams.

 Passion for mentoring, coaching, and developing technical talent   Excellent verbal and written communication skills   Ability to explain technical concepts to individuals with varying levels of We are in search of a highly motivated candidate to join our talented Team.            Job Title:  Software Dev Engineer IV     Location:  Herndon, VA     Job Responsibilities:     Design, develop, implement, test, document and deploy full-stack, cloud-native, contact center-related software applications, tools, systems and services using multi-threaded programming, development in Python and React/node.js, implementing architecture patterns and design patterns, and utilizing generative AI large language models.   Assist in gathering and analyzing business and functional requirements, and translate requirements into technical specifications for robust, scalable, supportable solutions that work well within the overall system architecture.   Own delivery of entire piece of system or application, and serve as technical lead on complex projects using best practice engineering standards.   Produce comprehensive, usable software documentation.         Required Qualifications:     MS or BS in Computer Science, Computer or Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field, plus five years of progressively responsible experience in the job offered or related occupations of Software Engineer, Software Developer, or related.         Required technical skills:     Coding proficiency in Python, and front-end development experience with Javascript/React.   Proficiency development with services such as AWS Lambda, Step Functions, DynamoDB, AppSync, Bedrock, SageMaker, and CloudWatch.   Proficiency in developing and integrating with REST-based or GraphQL-based APIs.   Proficiency in developing infrastructure-as-code deployment solutions such as AWS CloudFormation or AWS CDK.   Experience collaborating with other developers using git repositories, including creating and managing feature branches, pull requests, code merge, and GitHib actions or equivalent.         Top 3 must-have skills:     Generative AI based coding   AWS serverless   Python and JavaScript/React         Preferred skills:     Experience with Contact Center development and telephony infrastructure.   Experience with prompt engineering for modern large language models.   Experience using modern AI-based agentic coding assistants for code development, test development, and documentation.   Track record of building successful serverless architectures following AWS Well Architected principles.              Ampcus is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veterans or individuals with disabilities.

evidence.text: Built a serverless data platform in Python, AWS Lambda, and Firebase, automating async workflows and processing behavioral data for 3K+ users via REST API integrations.

skills.label: Python
skills.source: Request ID: 114408-1  Title: Snowflake Cortex AI Engineer  Locations: Las Vegas, NV  Duration: 06+ Months  Pay Range: $50-$53/Hour on W2/C2C (All inclusive)    We are seeking a highly skilled  Senior AI Data Engineer  with expertise in  Snowflake, Cortex AI, Python, AI Agents, and modern data engineering platforms . The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing and implementing AI-powered data solutions, developing RAG-based applications, building scalable data pipelines, and deploying enterprise-grade AI solutions leveraging Snowflake's AI ecosystem.   This role combines Data Engineering, AI/ML Integration, Solution Architecture, and Customer Engagement to deliver innovative, production-ready AI applications.     Key Responsibilities     Design and implement AI-powered solutions using  Snowflake Cortex AI, CoCO, and CoCO Desktop .   Develop and deploy  RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)  applications, AI agents, semantic search solutions, and agentic workflows.   Architect scalable data platforms using  Snowflake, Kafka, Spark, Airflow, dbt, and cloud-native services .   Build and optimize ELT/ETL pipelines for batch and real-time data processing.   Develop enterprise AI applications leveraging LLMs, vector search, and AI orchestration frameworks.   Implement data modeling, semantic layers, governance, security, and performance optimization within Snowflake.   Lead architecture reviews, workshops, proof-of-concepts (PoCs), and production deployments.   Collaborate with business stakeholders, product teams, and customers to translate requirements into scalable solutions.   Create reusable frameworks, accelerators, and best practices for AI and data engineering initiatives.   Ensure adherence to enterprise security, privacy, compliance, and governance standards.       Required Skills   AI & Snowflake     Snowflake Architecture   Snowflake Cortex AI   CoCO & CoCO Desktop   Snowpark   AI Agents   RAG Applications   Vector Search   Semantic Layer Design   LLM Integration     Data Engineering     Python   PySpark   SQL   Snowflake   Airflow   dbt   Kafka   Spark   ELT/ETL Pipeline Development   Real-Time Data Processing     Data Platforms     Hive   Trino   Data Lake Architectures   Data Warehousing   Analytics Engineering     Cloud Technologies     AWS / Azure / GCP   Cloud-Native Data Services     Development Practices     Agile Scrum   CI/CD   Git   Solution Architecture   Performance Optimization       Preferred Skills     Snowflake Architect / Data Engineer Certifications   Streamlit   Dynamic Tables   Snowpipe   Snowflake Native Apps   OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini Integration   Linux   OpenShift   Kubernetes   Apache Superset   Enterprise Security & Governance

evidence.text: Interviewed 500+ engineering candidates over 3 years with a standardized technical program and scoring rubrics for Java, Python and cloud teams.
