skills.label: HTML
skills.source: Ampcus Inc. is a certified global provider of a broad range of Technology and Business consulting services. We are in search of a highly motivated candidate to join our talented Team.      Job Title:  Information Technology - Software Engineer.   Location:  Canton, MD.         Description:   Purpose     Responsible for design and development of sales force applications for FEP Local claim data processing systems in health care domain by understanding requirements, coding, testing, debugging applications.   The position makes sure the application develops properly with high quality products.   Primary accountability for development work takes place during the life cycle for those projects, from planning to implementation.   Provides high quality products that are reviewed and approved by the team and Bridge plans.   Provides technical oversight and supports IT project teams to deliver high quality FEP products for business needs.     Essential Functions   50% Salesforce Application development:     Develop efficient and effective productions to deliver FEP business needs.   Serve as Salesforce application developer for new development of Salesforce applications as well as enhancement of existing applications to FEP users and other application integrations.   Communicate with other team members including developer/tester/business analyst to deliver product without gaps and best performance.   Main role of development code, review code, deployment of code to upper environments and maintenance of code.   Support D2D request and debugging issue to resolve issues. Also publishes technical documents and knowledge sharing with teams.     20% Design of system/ Analysis requirement implementation to new/existing systems:     Understand requirements and current systems well so develop systems properly based on requirement and resolution for fixing an issue/enhancement.   Study and understanding new features and services from Salesforce and each Salesforce release so that FEP salesforce applications be implements better performance of process and services.     20% Testing/Technical Support:     Develop Unit testing code and support automation testing implementation for delivery of high quality of code.   Perform troubleshooting and debugging an issue and analysis of issue and provide best resolution to teams. Supporting D2D as well as developments to different environments.     10% Collaborate to drive business value:     Work closely with other development team members, the project manager, and product managers to ensure applications to be developing properly with requirement and needs, also deliver it in time with high quality of products.     Qualifications:     Education Level: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, related IT field or equivalent work experience   Required Minimum Qualifications: 1 Year of experience in building, deploying and supporting sales force applications and platform solutions.     Preferred Qualifications:     Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field preferred.   Experience with Salesforce application development.   Experience with web programming including HTML, CSS and JavaScript.   Experience of custom solutions on Salesforce platform working with Lightning Web Components, Apex Triggers, Apex Classes, Flow, Visualforce, SOQL.   Experience building REST APIs for external systems integrations.   Experience with object-oriented programming design patterns and Salesforce data modeling best practices.   Experience developing reporting and dashboards in Salesforce.   Experience with JIRA or Agile platform for collaborating with multiple teams and source control system like Git/SVN.   Excellent verbal and written communication skills.   Excellent presentation skills with the ability to collaborate with team members and business stakeholders.   Experience in multi-cloud architecture and AWS cloud development is a plus.   Experience in a call center setup within Salesforce is plus.   Experience working with CI/CD pipelines like Copado and knowledgeable are plus.   Understanding & knowledge of AI is a plus.   Agentforce 360 experience & knowledge is a plus.   Development using AI tools like Agentforce DX, Agentforce vibes are a plus.   Data 360 experience or knowledge is a plus.   Integration with other SAAS systems is a plus.                 Ampcus is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veterans or individuals with disabilities.

skills.source: Our client is currently seeking a Full Stack Developer - IV 			 Job Title: Full Stack Developer - Iv    Hybrid, 2-3 days in the office (Not negotiable)     Location: Ashburn, VA, Baskin Ridge, NJ          The roles and responsibilities of this position includes :    - Partnering with architects, cross group SMEs, team leads and vendors to build software solutions in the wireless stack using Agile methodologies.     - Leading multiple media to large modules of the software platform.    - Engaged with architects and leads to develop POCs and recommend optimized software solutions.     - Development of Message Listener and asynchronous data processing technologies.     - Ability to translate legacy mainframe code into solutions using latest technologies     - Work with build and deployment teams to resolve any code deployment issues.     - Communicate technical details to various audience types. Requires strong written and oral communication skills.     - Problem solving skills to develop quick yet sound solutions to resolve complex issues     - Candidate would be required to support production activity on release launch days.          Responsibilities:     - Analyze legacy systems, reverse engineer solutions, assess impacts and define technical designs.     - Design and building of Micro Services using Java/J2EE Technologies, Camel framework, Spring framework.     - Experienced in using web service technologies like SOAP/ Rest API. Monitoring and supporting high volume web service integrations.     - Experience in developing responsive web design, and cross-browsers compatibility.     - Managing time effectively to work on multiple project timelines simultaneously in a demanding deadline driven environment.     - Hands-on experience with source control system such as Accurev, Maven, Git Candidate should be able to apply commonly used integration patterns and should be self-sufficient to independently develop a solution given the business requirements and high-level design.     - Working experience in RMQ, JMS, Kafka - Knowledge of DBMS technologies like Oracle, PostGres, Cassandra, Redis.     - Ability to containerize and deploy applications in a Cloud environment.     - Experienced working on workflow integrations     - Experienced working on Front-end like ReactJS.     - Hands-on experience with static analysis tools such as Sonar Cube, Fortify     - Conducts unit tests, code reviews, establishes high coding standards, assesses and improves site/software performance.     - Test business processes/products across applications with an end-to-end process flow System & Network Security     - Familiarity working with projects tracking systems, such as Jira.

skills.source: Request ID: 80620-1  Title: Software Engineer (Device Testing)  Locations: Cupertino, CA 95014 (5x/ week onsite)   Duration: 6 Months  Salary Range: $55 - $59/Hour on W2 (All inclusive)   Introduction   We are seeking a skilled Software Engineer in Device Testing to join our team for a 6-month contract. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in device testing and a passion for ensuring the quality of cutting-edge technologies.   Required Skills & Qualifications     Must be willing to work 5 days onsite from Cupertino, CA location.   2 years of hands-on device testing experience.   Programming and automation experience with Python and Java.   Experience with device automation frameworks including XCUI.   Ability to analyze logs and debug issues across distributed systems.   Understanding of backend services and system integrations.   Experience validating workflows involving devices, backend services, and data pipelines.   Prior work experience at client or in client's Industry.   Applicants must be able to work directly for Artech on W2.     Preferred Skills & Qualifications     Good understanding of database connectivity and data access, connecting to data sources and SQL.   Familiarity with containerization, cloud platforms such as AWS or GCP, and data pipeline technologies such as Kafka and Spark.   Strong debugging skills and ability to independently triage issues.     Day-to-Day Responsibilities     Execute E2E testing across devices, backend services, data pipelines, browser UI, and supporting systems.   Validate functionality of unreleased device features and server-side platform changes.   Develop, maintain, and manually test scenarios.   Investigate failures and perform root cause triage across the system stack including devices, backend services, and data pipelines.   Analyze logs and system telemetry to identify the source of issues.   Work with internal engineering teams to provide actionable defect reports with clear reproduction steps and supporting diagnostics.   Support validation of cross-system workflows involving devices, backend services, and data pipelines.     Company Benefits & Culture     Opportunity to work on innovative and cutting-edge technologies.   Collaborative and dynamic work environment.   Professional growth and development opportunities.     For immediate consideration please click APPLY to begin the screening process with Alex.

evidence.text: Interviewed 500+ engineering candidates over 3 years with a standardized technical program and scoring rubrics for Java, Python and cloud teams.

skills.label: AWS
skills.source: Job Summary The Data Analyst - IV will serve as a hands-on Senior Technical Analyst supporting the Client's Common Data Platform (CDP), a cloud-based, end-to-end data management platform designed to reduce data costs and improve user experience across the Client's . This is a 1-year contract assignment focused on technical analysis, AI Agent automation, AWS production support, monitoring, and observability. The role involves supporting complex integrated systems, troubleshooting production issues, identifying root causes, implementing automated operational workflows, and ensuring data pipelines remain scalable, secure, and efficient. The CDP program uses the Scaled Agile Framework for Enterprises (SAFe) to deliver incremental business value. This position requires a hands-on technical contributor rather than a manager or architect. Key Responsibilities •    Provide primary technical support to end users for software issues, data problems, data communication errors, and processing failures. •    Provide hands-on production support for applications running on Kubernetes and high-performance computing (HPC) clusters, including incident triage, root cause analysis, and resolution. •    Monitor application production environments and provide technical and user support for new releases and implementations. •    Assess existing production support processes and identify opportunities for automation using AI Agents. •    Design, build, and deploy AWS AI Agents using Amazon Bedrock Agents to automate repetitive support tasks, incident triage, and operational workflows. •    Develop agent skills and action groups for operational use cases such as log analysis, alert correlation, and automated remediation. •    Integrate AI Agents with observability and monitoring tools, including CloudWatch, Grafana, and Container Insights, to enable intelligent responses to production issues. •    Collaborate with support, platform, and application teams to convert manual runbooks and standard operating procedures into automated, agent-driven workflows. •    Ensure AI Agent development and deployment comply with Client's  security, risk, and regulatory requirements, including data handling, model governance, and access controls. •    Work with Databricks data pipelines to provide AI Agents with relevant operational and support data for decision-making. •    Build and maintain GitLab CI/CD pipelines for agent deployment, versioning, and lifecycle management. •    Document agent architecture, workflows, decision logic, and governance compliance for support teams and auditors. •    Train and transfer knowledge to internal support teams on using, maintaining, and extending AI Agent capabilities. •    Participate in ongoing production support and maintain continuity between manual and automated processes during the transition. •    Consult on application testing strategies, document observations, and coordinate responses. •    Maintain project and application documentation, including schedules, system scope, requirements, and other relevant information. •    Coordinate information flow between business owners and development teams. •    Coordinate tasks, functional reviews, and application development sessions between development sites and technical workgroups, ensuring timely execution. •    Document end-user interactions in automated call-logging tools for tracking and productivity purposes. •    Evaluate proposed technical approaches to system and application problem logs and recommend remediation strategies to management. •    Recommend process improvements and demonstrate creativity in addressing problems, issues, and opportunities. •    Support Agile delivery activities, including requirements engineering, backlog development, and backlog refinement. •    Engage stakeholders and collaborate with distributed teams and software solution providers. •    Apply application and data modeling techniques to identify root causes and recommend appropriate solutions. •    Work effectively across support, platform engineering, security, and end-user teams. •    Provide periodic on-call support during either the 8:00 AM–2:00 PM ET or 2:00 PM–8:00 PM ET shift, Monday through Friday. Required Qualifications •    Hands-on experience building and deploying AWS AI Agents, specifically using Amazon Bedrock Agents. •    Experience designing agent skills and action groups for operational tasks. •    Understanding of prompt engineering, knowledge bases, and agent orchestration within Amazon Bedrock. •    Experience integrating AI Agents with APIs and operational tools. •    Strong hands-on experience with AWS services, including Lambda, Bedrock, S3, IAM, CloudWatch, EventBridge, and Step Functions. •    Experience automating AWS production environment tasks, including automated remediation and alert handling. •    Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform or AWS CloudFormation for deploying agent and automation infrastructure. •    Experience integrating AI and automation solutions with observability tools such as CloudWatch, Grafana, and Container Insights. •    Experience with GitLab CI/CD for automation and agent deployment pipelines. •    Working knowledge of Databricks for data access and integration supporting agent decision-making. •    Understanding of AI/ML governance considerations, including model risk, data privacy, and auditability, particularly in regulated or financial services environments. •    Ability to work within the client's security and compliance framework for AI and automation deployments. •    Experience translating manual support processes and runbooks into automated workflows. •    Strong documentation skills for architecture, agent logic, operational workflows, and governance compliance. •    Ability to train support teams on new automated tools and workflows. •    Hands-on experience providing production support for applications running on Kubernetes and HPC clusters. •    Experience with incident triage, root cause analysis, troubleshooting, and production issue resolution. •    Strong experience in Agile delivery, requirements engineering, backlog development, and refinement. •    Strong experience working in an Agile environment using the SAFe framework and tools such as Jira. •    Experience engaging stakeholders and working with distributed teams and software solution providers. •    Broad knowledge of application and data modeling techniques, with the ability to identify root causes and recommend solutions. •    Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and design skills. •    Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to train and mentor technical and non-technical audiences. •    Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work independently while helping build team capabilities. •    Strong customer service orientation and patience when explaining or simplifying technical concepts. •    Willingness to provide periodic on-call support during the specified weekday shifts. Preferred Qualifications •    Prior experience with Amazon Bedrock, including Agents, Knowledge Bases, and Guardrails.

skills.label: Python
skills.source: Ampcus Inc. is a certified global provider of a broad range of Technology and Business consulting services. We are in search of a highly motivated candidate to join our talented Team.    Project Overview   We are seeking an experienced Full Stack Developer for a consulting role to support ongoing and future projects. The consultant will be instrumental in developing and maintaining sophisticated applications using .NET Core and Python for backend development, and React or NextJS for frontend development. This role requires significant expertise in deploying applications to Azure App Services, managing code repositories via DevOps or GitHub, and utilizing Azure managed identities for secure resource access. Additionally, the candidate should have comprehensive knowledge of Azure AD and Azure B2C authentication.   Job Functions & Responsibilities     Develop, test, and maintain high-quality web applications using .NET Core and Python.   Design and implement responsive and dynamic user interfaces using React or NextJS.   Implement RESTful APIs and integrate with third-party services.   Collaborate closely with our teams and stakeholders to gather requirements, provide technical insights, and translate them into detailed technical specifications.   Utilize DevOps or GitHub for efficient version control, continuous integration, and continuous deployment (CI/CD) processes.   Deploy and manage applications on Azure App Services, ensuring optimal performance, scalability, and reliability.   Implement and manage Azure managed identities to ensure secure access to resources.   Integrate Azure AD and Azure B2C authentication into applications to manage user identities and access securely.   Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve complex application issues to maintain high performance and responsiveness.   Conduct thorough code reviews to uphold code quality standards and foster knowledge-sharing within the team.   Stay abreast of emerging technologies and industry trends to continuously enhance development practices.   Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior developers, fostering a collaborative and innovative team environment.   Adapt to various projects and client needs, demonstrating flexibility and expertise in consulting engagements.   Communicate effectively with clients to understand their requirements and deliver solutions that meet their business objectives.     Skills     Extensive experience in backend development using .NET Core and Python.   Advanced proficiency in frontend technologies such as React or NextJS.   Strong knowledge of RESTful API development and integration with third-party services.   Familiarity with SQL Server or other relational databases and ORM frameworks.   Deep understanding of version control systems and CI/CD pipelines, specifically using DevOps or GitHub.   Expertise in deploying and managing applications on Azure App Services.   Strong knowledge of Azure managed identities for secure and efficient resource access.   Comprehensive knowledge of Azure AD and Azure B2C authentication for managing user identities and access securely.   Exceptional problem-solving skills with a demonstrated ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex issues.   Excellent communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.   Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks and projects simultaneously.   Ability to adapt to different projects and client needs, demonstrating flexibility and expertise in consulting engagements.   Commitment to continuous learning and staying updated with the latest technological advancements.     Education & Certifications     Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field is required.   Professional certifications in .NET, Python, React, Azure, or DevOps are highly desirable.   Additional certifications or specialized training in cloud computing, particularly Azure, will be considered an advantage.     Ampcus is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veterans or individuals with disabilities.

evidence.text: Interviewed 500+ engineering candidates over 3 years with a standardized technical program and scoring rubrics for Java, Python and cloud teams.

skills.label: Python
skills.source: Job Description:	 Ansible Playbooks & Roles: Writing idempotent playbooks, structuring roles for reusability, managing dependencies. YAML & Jinja2: Deep understanding of YAML syntax, Jinja2 templating, filters, and conditionals for dynamic configuration. Inventory Management: Building dynamic and static inventories, grouping, host variables, and integration with external sources Linux Administration: Strong proficiency with common distributions (RHEL, Ubuntu, Debian, Alpine), package management, systemd, networking config, and security hardening. Windows Support: Ansible Windows modules, PowerShell remediation, and Active Directory integration (if applicable). Infrastructure Abstraction: Combining Ansible with Terraform or CloudFormation for hybrid approaches or using Ansible alone for configuration post-provisioning. Container & Kubernetes: Ansible for cluster bootstrapping, pod/ deployment management, and container runtime configuration. Version Control: Git workflows for playbook/role repositories, branching strategies, and pull-request-based reviews. CI/CD Integration: Embedding Ansible runs in GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or Azure Pipelines for automated testing, linting (ansible-lint), and deployment. Testing & Validation: Using Molecule for role testing, TestInfra for server validation, and integration with schema/ policy checks. Secrets Management: Integrating with HashiCorp Vault, Ansible Vault, or cloud KMS for secure handling of passwords, API keys, and TLS certificates. Compliance & Auditing: Ensuring playbooks meet organizational security standards, generating compliance reports, and maintaining audit trails. Networking Basics: DNS, DHCP, VPCs/subnets, load balancers, firewalls, and IP address management. Other IaC Tools: Familiarity with Terraform, Pulumi, or CloudFormation helps when designing hybrid or multi-cloud strategies. Observability: Wiring Ansible outputs into monitoring stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Splunk) for drift detection and operational visibility. Scripting & Automation: Python or Bash for custom modules, hooks, or glue code between Ansible and other tooling.  			  			 Medical, dental, and vision insurance are available to qualified candidates who meet eligibility requirements.

skills.label: Python
skills.source: Please see job description attached!  *** is looking for an AI Engineer to design, build and run the agents that automate work across our digital commerce and transformation programs. The role is hands-on and product-minded: you take a business workflow, decide where an agent genuinely helps, and deliver a governed agent that people use every day. The work is built primarily on Client's AI platform, spanning Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Client Copilot Studio and the Client 365 and Teams surfaces where our teams already work.   This is a production engineering role rather than a prototyping one. Agents you build are expected to clear the *** Agentic Framework bar before they reach users: registered in the Agent Registry, authenticated through Client Entra, authorized under least-privilege RBAC, instrumented for observability, and certified through evaluation testing. You own that path end to end, from the first system prompt and tool schema through deployment, monitoring and iteration.   You will work alongside program managers, data engineers, BI developers, solution architects and security partners, and you will spend as much time defining what good looks like as writing code. Strong candidates are comfortable with ambiguity, opinionated about evaluation, and able to explain in plain language what an agent can do, what it cannot, and how they know.  What We Look For in a Candidate  Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, data science or a related technical field, or equivalent hands-on experience.  Four or more years of software engineering experience, including at least one year building LLM-based or agent-based applications that reached production users.  Strong Python skills, with C# or TypeScript an advantage, and fluency with asynchronous APIs, REST and GraphQL, JSON schemas and Git-based workflows.  Hands-on experience with Client AI services, including Azure AI Foundry or Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, and at least one of Copilot Studio, Semantic Kernel or the Client Agent Framework.  Practical retrieval-augmented generation experience covering chunking strategy, embeddings, vector search, reranking and retrieval evaluation.  Working knowledge of Model Context Protocol or comparable tool-calling and function-calling patterns, including schema design and versioning.  Demonstrated skill in prompt and context engineering, including system prompts, few-shot design and model-specific behavior.  Experience evaluating LLM systems with offline and online methods, regression suites and human review loops, and a clear point of view on what is worth measuring.  Familiarity with Client Entra ID, OAuth2 and JWT, role-based access control and API gateway patterns.  Experience with CI/CD, containers, infrastructure as code and observability tooling such as Azure Monitor, Application Insights and OpenTelemetry.  Clear written communication, including the ability to explain agent behavior, limits and failure modes to partners who are not engineers.  Sound judgment about where an agent is the right answer, and the willingness to say plainly when it is not.  Also valuable  Client certification such as Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102) or an Azure architecture credential.  Experience with Power Platform, including Power Automate and Dataverse, or with Client Fabric and Power BI.  Telecommunications, order management, billing or business-to-business commerce domain experience.  Contributions to agent platform tooling, registries, evaluation frameworks or internal developer experience.

evidence.text: Interviewed 500+ engineering candidates over 3 years with a standardized technical program and scoring rubrics for Java, Python and cloud teams.

You will play a critical role in designing, building, and optimizing AI solutions that leverage  NVIDIA GPUs  within a  Red Hat OpenShift  platform.    You’ll work across the full AI development lifecycle—from rapid prototyping in  Jupyter Notebooks  to deploying scalable, production-grade systems.             Responsibilities       Develop & Fine-Tune AI Models : Build and      optimize LLMs and other deep learning models tailored to project needs.    Design Agentic AI Systems : Architect and      implement multi-agent AI workflows capable of autonomous task execution.    GPU Optimization on OpenShift : Deploy and manage      AI/ML workloads on OpenShift, ensuring efficient GPU utilization.    Python & Jupyter Development : Use Python and      Jupyter for prototyping, experimentation, and model training.    Pipeline & Infrastructure Management : Maintain robust      data/model pipelines and troubleshoot performance bottlenecks in      containerized environments.    Cross-Functional Collaboration : Partner with data      scientists, engineers, and project managers to deliver high-impact AI      solutions.               Minimum Qualifications       Proven experience developing AI systems,      including LLMs and agentic AI architectures.    Advanced proficiency in  Python  and      experience with frameworks like  PyTorch ,  TensorFlow ,  LangChain ,      and  Hugging Face .    Hands-on expertise with  Jupyter      Notebooks  for model development.    Direct experience deploying containerized      AI workloads using  NVIDIA GPUs  on  Red Hat      OpenShift .    Strong understanding of  Docker ,  Kubernetes ,      and  CI/CD  practices.    Excellent problem-solving skills in      high-performance computing environments.    Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science,      Engineering, or a related field—or equivalent practical experience.               Preferred Qualifications       Experience with distributed training and      model serving at scale.    Familiarity with MLOps tools and practices.    Contributions to open-source AI projects or      research publications.

evidence.text: FastAPI microservices with Docker Redis; sub-200ms REST for enterprise telecom integrations.

skills.label: Python
skills.source: Title: Data Analyst II      Duration: 3 months      Location : Remote worker located in New Jersey, Pennsylvania, Chicago, IL.      Only looking for W2 candidates          Partner with MDS in providing accessibility, retrievability, security and protection of data in an ethical manner.    Parter with Product Owners, BI Developers and Business Leads to conduct business requirement gathering & continuous improvement sessions to support the business and understand requirements for analytical projects and develop necessary requirement documents and acceptance criteria to support their development in line with process guidelines    Develop UAT (User Acceptance Testing) and SIT (System Integration Testing) test cases based off analytical data product requirements.    Support for scoping, building, testing, and maintaining transport/data pipelines and retrieving applicable data sets for specific use cases.    Support building, testing, and maintaining data models with the flexibility to change when business requirements change, while also reconciling multiple logical source models into a single, logically consistent model.    Analyze the structure, format, and reliability of new and existing data sources, considering factors such as data integrity, completeness, accuracy, and drive continuous improvement.    Participate in data governance processes to ensure data is properly maintained and document for reusability by the business    Understand data and metadata to support consistency of information retrieval, combination, analysis, pattern recognition and interpretation.      What you will bring    A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career and the following experience and knowledge:     Understanding of Data Engineering concepts within a business setting, including working with multiple systems such as SAP, internal and external data sources. skills.source: Spotlight Call: Thursday, September 24th a 1pm est  Experience: Junior Developer  Location: US Virtual (Remote)    Job Description  We are seeking a Junior Developer to join the development team for one of our product lines. The product has built a hosted diagnostic imaging and telemedicine platform, custom built with current web technologies and tools, deployed on AWS in an agile Scrum environment. It gives our customers access to and collaboration on diagnostic radiology. You will work across our full stack .NET, Java, Python, React, and Angular alongside a closely-knit team of developers, designers, product managers, and QA testers. All candidates must have excellent communication skills, attention to detail, at least 3 years of relevant experience, and the ability to multitask in a deadline-oriented environment. The best fit will be a well-rounded individual with a desire to learn and grow, including learning to use AI tools like Claude to work more efficiently.    What will you do?  Design, code, test, debug, and document programs based on technical configurations developed by analysts and project teams. Estimate and track time required to complete work for project budgeting and financial tracking.  Develop program designs to meet technical configurations, ensuring resulting systems operate efficiently and reliably. Understand the business function supported by the application and ensure designs integrate with other related systems.  Code across our stack, using .NET, Java, Python, React, and Angular as appropriate to the task.  Test and debug programs to finalize and ensure smooth operation.  Document program design, coding, and other details to guide others in application development, use, and maintenance.  Support, update, and maintain existing systems in response to business needs, system problems, or other factors. Coordinate with project teams to design, code, test, and document system changes.  Coordinate with project team members to define application requirements. Identify business needs, assess available technologies, and develop and present solutions.  Use Claude and other AI tools to speed up coding, testing, debugging, and documentation, and share efficiency practices with the team.  Provide a high level of customer service, partnering with end users in the resolution of problems or in deployment of new applications.  Participate as an active member of a cross-functional Agile Scrum team.    What do you need to succeed?  At least 3 years of relevant software development experience.  Familiarity with the application development process.  Experience with, or strong interest in learning, .NET, Java, Python, React, and Angular.  Experience with HTML, JavaScript, and building web UIs.  Experience with, or willingness to learn, relational databases (Oracle, MySQL, SQL Server) and Structured Query Language (SQL).  Comfort using AI tools such as Claude to write, review, test, or document code more efficiently.  Excellent problem-solving skills.  Excellent customer service and business relationship building skills.  Strong communication skills, both verbal and written, including the ability to translate technical subject matter to non-technical audiences.  Ability to work independently and within a cross-functional Agile Scrum team.    Preferred Experience:  BA/BS in Computer Science (or related field) and/or equivalent work experience.  Experience handling raw image data or image files strongly preferred.  Familiarity with AWS.  Knowledge of system monitoring tools like AWS Console and Datadog.  Experience transforming business requirements into elegant designs and clean, unit-tested code. skills.source: Ampcus Inc. is a certified global provider of a broad range of Technology and Business consulting services. We are in search of a highly motivated candidate to join our talented Team.      Job Title:  Full Stack Developer.   Location(s):  Pleasanton, CA.        Role Overview:     You will be responsible for developing and maintaining both the front-end and back-end components of web applications, ensuring robust performance and scalability.   If you’re passionate about building high-quality applications and enjoy working in a collaborative environment, we’d love to hear from you.     Key Requirements:     Proficiency in Java, J2EE, Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) and Exception handling .   Hands-on experience with Apache Kafka and the Spring Boot framework .   Strong knowledge of both SQL databases (Oracle) and NoSQL databases (MongoDB, Cassandra).   Experience using build tools such as Maven and Gradle.   Familiarity with RESTful web services. Experience with version control systems such as Git (GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket).              Ampcus is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veterans or individuals with disabilities.

Location(s):  Pleasanton, CA.        Role Overview:     You will be responsible for developing and maintaining both the front-end and back-end components of web applications, ensuring robust performance and scalability.   If you’re passionate about building high-quality applications and enjoy working in a collaborative environment, we’d love to hear from you.     Key Requirements:     Proficiency in Java, J2EE, Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) and Exception handling .   Hands-on experience with Apache Kafka and the Spring Boot framework .   Strong knowledge of both SQL databases (Oracle) and NoSQL databases (MongoDB, Cassandra).   Experience using build tools such as Maven and Gradle.   Familiarity with RESTful web services.   Proficiency in front-end technologies: HTML, CSS and JavaScript.   Experience with version control systems such as Git (GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket).              Ampcus is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veterans or individuals with disabilities.

skills.label: Java
skills.source: Dev10 is seeking a Full Stack Software Engineering Instructor (Java) for a Remote position. This is an 8+ month contract-to-hire opportunity.   This position is ideal for a software developer who enjoys teaching, mentoring, and helping others launch successful careers in technology. The successful candidate will guide Associates through an intensive software engineering training program focused on Java, full-stack development, databases, APIs, testing, and modern software engineering practices. In addition to delivering instruction and providing technical coaching, the Instructor will collaborate with fellow instructors to continuously improve curriculum and ensure students are prepared to meet the evolving needs of clients and the technology industry.   Responsibilities:     Participate in training activities daily during core hours of 9:00 AM - 4:00 PM CT   Deliver technical instruction, demonstrations, workshops, and Q&A sessions   Create an engaging and supportive learning environment that promotes student success   Monitor student progress and provide coaching to help Associates achieve learning objectives   Support and troubleshoot student challenges during labs, exercises, and project work   Foster confidence, accountability, and problem-solving skills among Associates   Conduct weekly code reviews and provide detailed, constructive feedback   Evaluate technical assignments against established standards and best practices   Meet one-on-one with Associates who need additional support or guidance   Collaborate with the instructional team to continuously improve curriculum and training materials   Support technical evaluations used during the recruiting process   Mentor new instructors as they develop classroom management and instructional skills     Requirements:     3+ years of professional software development experience   Strong understanding of full-stack software engineering principles and practices   Passion for mentoring, coaching, and developing technical talent   Excellent verbal and written communication skills   Ability to explain technical concepts to individuals with varying levels of experience   Strong collaboration and interpersonal skills   Java   Object-Oriented Programming (OOP)   SQL and Relational Databases   APIs and Web Services   HTML   CSS   Git and Version Control   Command Line/Terminal Fundamentals   Test-Driven Development (TDD)   Software Testing Principles   Web Security and Authentication   Software Design and Development Best Practices     Desired skills:     Previous experience as a technical instructor, trainer, educator, teaching assistant, or mentor   Experience leading technical workshops, bootcamps, or training programs   Experience reviewing and providing feedback on code   Background in full-stack web application development   Experience coaching junior developers or early-career technology professionals   Familiarity with cloud platforms such as Azure or AWS   Exposure to AI-assisted development tools, Generative AI, or Agentic application development   Curriculum development or instructional design experience     Pay range: $110,000 - $150,000 annually   Only candidates available and ready to work directly as Genesis10 employees will be considered for this position.   If you have the described qualifications and are interested in this exciting opportunity, please apply!   Benefits of Working with Genesis10 / Dev10:     Medical, Dental, Vision   Health Savings Account   Voluntary Hospital Indemnity (Critical Illness & Accident)   Voluntary Term Life Insurance   401K   Sick Pay (for applicable states/municipalities)   Commuter Benefits (Dallas, NYC, SF, and Illinois)   Fun & flexible team environment     Genesis10 is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Candidates will receive consideration without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

evidence.text: Delivered Fortune 500 Java systems for Fidelity, British Telecom and T-Mobile over 3 years spanning secure insurance exchange, telecom commerce and an AWS operations platform for 3K employees.

skills.label: Python
skills.source: Position Overview   We are seeking passionate and seasoned professionals to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will help design, develop, and scale AI-enabling platform services and public APIs that are secure, reliable, and cloud-native. These services will act as foundational building blocks for AI adoption across our product portfolio and partner ecosystem.   You will be part of a Scrum team to build innovative, standards-compliant, secure, and production-grade AI capabilities, with a builder mindset, rapid prototyping, and continuous improvement with the agility of a start-up.   Key Responsibilities     Collaborate with multiple teams to create AI solutions, including AI model deployment, training, and AI tooling development.   Build scalable, fault-tolerant cloud-native services on Azure, ensuring high performance and reliability.   Develop secure, well-documented public APIs and SDKs for consumption by internal and external developers.   Work with cross-functional teams to deliver end-to-end solutions across data pipelines, orchestration, and service APIs.   Embed robust security controls to protect sensitive data and ensure secure access to AI services.     Essential Requirements     Experience working with Large Language Models (LLMs) and understanding trade-offs between performance, cost, and capability.   Understanding of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), agent orchestration, prompt engineering, and tool calling.   Familiarity with AI standards such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Agent2Agent (A2A).   Proficiency in developing code using AI Tools such as GitHub Copilot and prompt engineering.   Experience in Python and AI frameworks/tools such as PyTorch and TensorFlow.   Experience with tools for automated testing and evaluation of AI outputs.   Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to analyze complex technical challenges and propose scalable solutions.     Desired Skills and Competencies     Extensive experience in software engineering, preferably in platform or cloud-native service development using C# and .NET technologies.   Strong expertise in RESTful API design, versioning, testing, and lifecycle management.   Strong knowledge or experience in working with various ML algorithms (regression, classification, clustering, deep learning).   Proficient in securing APIs, managing authentication/authorization, and data privacy practices.   Hands-on experience with Azure and associated PaaS services; experience with other cloud platforms (AWS, GCP) is also valued.   Knowledge of AI ethics and regulations and commitment to responsible AI development.   Experience working in Agile teams and collaborating across global R&D locations.     Research & Development   Our global team of developers works on a diverse portfolio of industrial automation and engineering products. AI and cloud are at the center of our strategy, and we have a strong track record of innovation. If you want to build applications that solve big problems, join us.   Benefits   Enjoy flexible work hours, generous PTO, paid volunteering days, parental leave, well-being support, medical, dental, vision, and 401K. Specific benefits vary by country, but our packages are comprehensive.   Working Arrangement   We work in a hybrid way, with an expectation of being on-site 50% of your working hours to support collaboration and connection.

We are in search of a highly motivated candidate to join our talented Team.       Job Title:  Golang Backend Engineer   Location(s):  McLean, VA           As a Golang Backend Engineer, you'll be instrumental in designing and enhancing tools that contribute to efficiency, scalability, and streamlined operations within our organization. If you're a technically adept professional with a passion for driving seamless workflows, this is an opportunity you won't want to miss.   Responsibilities:     Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and enhance internal tools, spanning tasks such as scheduling, provisioning, tunnel services, upgrades, and data management.   Create and manage services, both for internal and customer-facing use, ensuring secure and efficient data transmission.   Develop internal services to streamline configuration management, pipeline updates, and more.   Architect and implement systems for efficient asset movement across storage systems, ensuring data integrity and accessibility.   Maintain a versatile toolbox to enhance developer workflows and streamline processes.     Experience:     Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).   Proven mastery of Golang and proficiency in Python or modern managed languages.   Familiarity with backing stores and databases including both SQL/NoSQL such as Postgres, Cassandra desirable   History of delivering products built on multiple frameworks such as Echo, Django, Flask   Demonstrated ability to not only code but also define, document, debug, and maintain Full stack applications   Familiarity with Kubernetes, cloud platforms, and network protocols.   An Agile mentality is required as we strive every sprint to design, code, test, and deliver solutions to our customers and in turn react and pivot based on their feedback   Excellent oral and written communication skills.   Should be equally capable of clarifying design points with architects and product owners as well as working with customer service to solve customer problems.       Ampcus is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identify, national origin, age, protected veterans or individuals with disabilities.

skills.source: Position Details:   Title:  Software Engineer 3 / Software Engineer 4   Location:  500 McCullough Ave, San Antonio, TX 78215   Duration:  12+ Months   Pay Rate:  Open to negotiate on W2   Job ID:  26-28282  Only USC/GC   Position Summary:  Designs, develops, tests, and maintains software programs based on customer requirements, using development standards and software development lifecycle process. Daily tasks may include requirements analysis, design, planning, programming, testing, documentation, error/exception handling, performance improvements and business process implementation. Tasks may also include analysis, research and recommendations for process implementation, performance and technology improvements. Demonstrates technical expertise through maintaining primary technical programming skills for assigned job, developing new skills as required, developing guidelines and standards, and demonstrating best practices and leadership.     Tasks and Responsibilities:     Designs, develops, tests, and maintains software solutions to meet customer requirements. Tasks required to complete this often include requirements analysis, documentation, error/exception handling, business process implementation, performance analysis/improvements and technology research.   Maintain technical skills through hands-on experience, independent research, training and/or conferences.   Strong understanding of secure cloud technologies.   Collaborates with leadership, product owners, architects, and business liaison to understand requirements.   Maintains and enhances existing system design through strong understanding of architecture and test-driven development skills.   Research and develop new technologies to enhance current and future design, security and system performance.   Strong understanding of Web Services and SOAP/REST integrations of third-party and remote systems.     Expert knowledge in optimizing SQL relational operations including direct query, caching mechanisms, read/write clustering, etc.   Strong understanding of DevOps best practices, Code Repository Branching/Merging, and system integrations.   Expert knowledge of code implementation, and upgrades of platform infrastructures.   Good understanding of the configuration and management of Apache Tomcat for hosting Java Web Applications.   Knowledge of SSL and Encryption methodologies, as well as an understanding of SSL implementations.   Good understanding of secure cloud technologies.   Ability to assist in the communication with customers, requirements gathering, design, analysis, documentation, and development of project assignments.   Technical skills necessary for developing architectural designs from gathered requirements.     Ability to develop full-stack application solutions.   Self-managed and motivated to maintain project deliverables and timelines.   Technical knowledge to identify gaps and complications in project designs.   Ability to professionally negotiate and challenge decisions, when necessary, to ensure project success.   Participate in Agile development methodology and ceremonies.   Performs other duties as assigned.      Minimum Qualifications:     Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Electrical Engineering from an accredited university OR Relevant technical programming experience.   Mid-level experience in web-based IT solutions.   Demonstrates at least two or more primary technical skill area listed here: Java and/or web programming, including JSP, Servlets, JDBC, web services, mobile, Angular, React, React Native, VueJS, JSON and HTML web development, Relational database design and application development (i.e., Oracle, DB2, etc.), including SQL queries, PL/SQL, Oracle APEX, DB2, etc., and Hands-on developer application server experience, including Apache Tomcat, WebSphere Application Server or other (preferred).   Proficient in using GitHub, including branching and merging.   Demonstrated ability to create and execute unit tests.   Object-oriented programming experience.   Mid-level experience with one or more development methodologies (i.e., waterfall, Agile, Rational Unified Process – RUP, etc.).   Demonstrates critical thinking problem solving skills on a semi-routing basis for creative and innovative solutions.   Demonstrates decision-making and communication skills to address customer issues, as well as analyze and clarify a new project assignment.   Ability to work well in a team environment.   Demonstrates technical writing skills.   Demonstrates customer service and situation-appropriate, professional customer communication.   Demonstrates time management and multi-tasking skills.   Independent thinking skills and ability to self-manage workload. Responsibilities are usually project oriented with general guidelines and references available.   Ability to work independently on project assignments, including communication with customers, requirements gathering, design, analysis, documentation, and development.   Understanding of APIs and modern technology architecture.      Preferred Qualifications:     Java Developer Certification(s).   Oracle or DB2 Certification(s).   Experience with Oracle AEM integrations.   Experience with Oracle Visual Builder.   Professional Experience in web-based IT solutions.   Experience in mobile responsive Web design.   Solid knowledge of OWASP and familiarity with web application vulnerabilities.   Demonstrates technical writing skills.   Demonstrates customer service and situation-appropriate, professional customer communication.   Demonstrates time management and multi-tasking skills.   Experience with CI/CD pipeline configurations and management.   Working knowledge of source control software (SVN or Git), build and deployment tools (Maven, Jenkins, Gradle).   Sharp troubleshooting skills and real-world systems deployment experience.      Working Conditions:     Environment  - Indoor work, operating computer, manual dexterity, talking, hearing, repetitive motion. Use of personal computing equipment, telephone, multi-functioning printer, and calculator. Ability to travel to and from meetings, training sessions, or other business-related events.   Physical Demands  - Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally, and/or a negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects including the human body. Sedentary work involves sitting most of the time. Jobs are sedentary if walking and standing are required only occasionally, and all other sedentary criteria are met.     Regards,   Alisha Keshri   Associate Recruiter   Artech Information System LLC   360Mt. Kemble Ave., suite 2000   Morristown, NJ 07960   Email:  Alisha.Keshri@artech.com ,  Website:  www.artech.com

Participate in system testing, validation, troubleshooting, and deployment activities.   Work with customers and departments on software design, support, and maintenance. Required Technical Skills     .NET Framework / .NET Core   C#   ASP.NET   Visual Studio   SQL Server   MVC   API development and integration   Relational database design and development   Client/server application development   Object-oriented programming principles   Application debugging and troubleshooting   Preferred Technical Skills   Python development and scripting   VB.NET   SSIS   Entity Framework or Dapper   Windows Presentation Foundation (WPF)   IIS   MSMQ   SQL performance tuning   UI design and development   Git, Azure DevOps, or similar source control platforms   Application performance troubleshooting and optimization   Experience integrating applications with manufacturing equipment, databases, or enterprise systems   Manufacturing Experience (Preferred)   Camstar MES or other Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES)   Manufacturing application support   Production environment troubleshooting   Manufacturing data collection and reporting systems   Quality, traceability, and process control systems   MES experience, including Camstar, is preferred but not required.       Soft Skills     Ability to work effectively within a small development team.   Strong written and verbal communication skills. Self-motivated with strong organizational skills and attention to detail. Optimize data workflows for scalability and performance.   Implement CI/CD principles and manage code repositories using GitHub Enterprise. skills.label: HTML
skills.source: Job Summary The Full Stack .NET Developer will design, develop, test, and maintain scalable web applications using C# and .NET/.NET Core while supporting modern frontend technologies, REST APIs, SQL databases, and Microsoft Azure integration services. The role requires experience integrating applications with enterprise systems and cloud services, participating in CI/CD activities, troubleshooting production issues, and supporting application deployments across development, QA, and production environments. Practical exposure to several Azure integration services is sufficient, with a willingness to work across the broader Azure ecosystem. Key Responsibilities •    Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable web applications using C# and .NET/.NET Core. •    Develop responsive and user-friendly frontend applications using Angular, React, or similar JavaScript frameworks. •    Build reusable, maintainable, and secure application components. •    Participate in application architecture, design discussions, and technical solution development. •    Perform code reviews and follow established coding and development standards. •    Troubleshoot application issues and perform root-cause analysis. •    Design and develop RESTful APIs and web services. •    Integrate applications with internal and external enterprise systems. •    Work with JSON, XML, authentication mechanisms, and API-based integration patterns. •    Implement synchronous and asynchronous integration patterns. •    Troubleshoot API and integration failures using application logs and monitoring tools. •    Develop and support cloud-based integrations using Microsoft Azure. •    Configure and support integrations between applications, APIs, databases, and enterprise systems. •    Monitor Azure-based applications and integrations and troubleshoot production issues. •    Work with development and infrastructure teams to deploy and maintain applications in Azure. •    Design and develop database queries, stored procedures, and data-access components. •    Participate in CI/CD activities using Azure DevOps or similar tools. •    Work with Git-based source control and branching strategies. •    Support application deployments across development, QA, and production environments. •    Troubleshoot deployment and environment-related issues. •    Develop unit and integration tests for application components and APIs. •    Participate in SIT/UAT and defect resolution. •    Analyze application logs and production issues to identify root causes. •    Support application releases and production deployments. •    Implement performance, security, and reliability improvements. Required Qualifications •    Strong experience with C# and .NET/.NET Core. •    Experience developing REST APIs and web services. •    Experience with Entity Framework/EF Core, LINQ, Dependency Injection, Object-Oriented Programming, and Design Patterns. •    Experience with Angular or React. •    Experience with JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3. •    Experience with responsive web development. •    Strong experience with Microsoft SQL Server and Cosmos DB. •    Experience developing stored procedures and optimizing database queries. •    Understanding of relational database concepts. •    Hands-on or working knowledge of Azure Functions, Azure Logic Apps, Azure Service Bus, Azure API Management, Azure Storage, Azure Event Grid, and Azure Application Insights. •    Experience with REST/API integration, JSON/XML, authentication, and authorization. •    Experience with Azure DevOps, Git, CI/CD concepts, and build and release pipelines. •    Experience participating in application deployments and production support. •    Experience developing unit and integration tests. •    Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. •    Good communication and collaboration skills. •    Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions. •    Ability to work independently and within cross-functional teams. •    Strong ownership of application development, troubleshooting, and delivery. •    Willingness to learn and expand knowledge of Azure cloud and integration technologies.

skills.label: Java
skills.source: The Content Platform team is looking for a Software Development Engineer. who will act as first level support and development for all incoming production software application issues dealing with merchandising applications. Your solutions will impact our customers directly! Primary responsibilities include developing monitoring solutions, troubleshooting/debugging and implementing the fix for internally developed code (Perl, C/C++, JAVA), performing SQL queries, improving our systems that gather metrics on our features, updating, tracking and resolving technical challenges. Responsibilities also include working alongside development on Amazon Corporate and Divisional Software projects, updating/enhancing our current software, automation of support processes and documentation of our systems. Job Qualifications:The ideal candidate is interested in a career in software development and is looking to utilize and expand their coding skills and gain exposure to a wide variety of software applications. They must be detail oriented, have superior verbal and written communication skills, strong organizational skills, are able to work independently and can maintain professionalism under pressure. Preferred coding skills: Perl, C/C++ and/or Java. Other desired technical skills include Mason, Perl CGI, Oracle SQL, HTML, UNIX/LINUX. A Computer Science or equivalent technical degree and 2-5 years of relevant experience is required.

skills.source: Do something big and innovative! Stretch your creative muscles and work on big issues.  Since 1989, we have developed technology environments, applications, and tools by providing experienced teams to implement, enhance, and maintain our clients’ essential systems and applications.  Come join the Artech team!       Job Title:  GIS Maps – Tools Analyst  Job ID: 26-40477   Location: Austin, TX 78727 | Fully Onsite      Role Summary:     We are seeking a technically skilled Tools Analyst to support GIS automation and data tooling initiatives within the Maps organization.   This role is focused on developing internal tooling to improve workflow efficiency, automate data analysis, and ensure data accuracy across large-scale geospatial datasets.   The ideal candidate has a strong command of scripting languages, experience working with geospatial data, and the ability to identify and analyze patterns across complex data systems.       Core Responsibilities     Design, maintain, and enhance internal tools and automation to improve efficiency, scalability, and reliability of GIS and data workflows.   Analyze large, structured datasets to identify trends, inconsistencies, and opportunities for process or tooling improvements.   Support data quality, validation, and monitoring efforts by evaluating outputs and surfacing systemic issues.   Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to translate operational needs into practical technical solutions.   Contribute to documentation, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement of tooling, processes, and analytical approaches.       Required Qualifications:     Bachelor’s degree in GIS, Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field.   2–3 years of experience working with SQL, Python, HiveQL, and Shell scripting in a data-rich environment.   Proficiency with Unix/Linux command line tools and file handling.   Demonstrated ability to analyze and interpret structured data in formats like JSON.   Experience working with large, distributed datasets and extracting insights across complex systems.   Strong organizational and documentation skills, with the ability to track and explain tool functionality clearly.   Ability to work independently and handle shifting project scopes or data priorities.       Preferred Skills:     Experience with QGIS or PostGIS for geospatial analysis and visualization.   Familiarity with data pipeline tools such as Jenkins, CircleCI, or similar automation platforms.   Background in GIS QA workflows and understanding of map data accuracy standards.   Prior experience with tooling to support data labeling, machine learning inputs, or prototyping environments.       Why Join Us:     Help build the next generation of GIS tools supporting real-world mapping and navigation products.   Be part of a high-impact team developing automation solutions that scale across global data operations.   Contribute to the advancement of geospatial technologies used by millions of users around the world.   Join a collaborative environment focused on innovation, problem-solving, and continuous improvement.         Please Contact: Angela Luis at 858-800-3007 or  angela.luis@artech.com        http://www.artech.com  Referrals welcome!  Referral bonus up to $1000!  Feel free to reach out for additional details

We are in search of a highly motivated candidate to join our talented Team.       Job Title:  Software Dev Engineer I   Location(s):  Sunnyvale, CA       Job Description:  The Agentic AI and Applied Foundation Model team is looking for a Software Development Engineer to improve the reliability, maintainability, and testability of complex robotic systems. You will build tools and infrastructure that help engineers diagnose failures, automate operational workflows, reproduce software environments, and understand exactly which software, models, firmware, configurations, and assets were used in each robot test.   This role sits at the intersection of robotics, developer infrastructure, automation, and machine learning systems. You will work with hardware, firmware, simulation, and applied ML teams to turn fragmented operational knowledge and manual processes into dependable software systems.   The ideal candidate is comfortable working across system boundaries, investigating ambiguous failures, and delivering practical tools that make other engineers more effective.   Key Responsibilities:     Develop tools for diagnosing, maintaining, and upgrading robotic systems.   Convert operational knowledge—such as troubleshooting sessions, runbooks, logs, and incident history—into structured, searchable, and context-aware support systems.   Build automation for operational workflows, including issue triage, ownership resolution, notifications, approvals, remediation, and escalation.   Design systems that safely automate actions on production or lab infrastructure while maintaining appropriate human review and auditability.   Build and maintain a registry of robots, test runs, software artifacts, machine-learning models, firmware versions, calibration data, configurations, and simulation assets.   Establish traceability between test inputs and results so experiments can be reproduced, compared, and audited.   Identify configuration and asset drift across development, simulation, and physical systems.   Create automated verification and regression-testing workflows for robotics software and infrastructure changes.   Reproduce robot software stacks in development or lab environments to support debugging, migration, and system-level testing.   Assist with separating software workloads from robot hardware and validating changes across different compute environments.   Support the testing and performance evaluation of optimized machine-learning inference paths.   Improve system observability through logging, metrics, dashboards, alerts, and diagnostic tooling.   Participate in design reviews, incident response, operational support, and continuous improvement of engineering processes.   Produce clear documentation and share technical knowledge across teams.     Basic Qualifications:     Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Robotics, or a related technical field, or equivalent professional experience. skills.source: To apply, please submit a formal application through our website:  Dev10 Apply Here     Please note: Applications submitted through this job posting will not be reviewed. You must apply via our site.     Important:  This role requires willingness to relocate anywhere in the United States.     Are you ready to break into the tech industry or take your technical skills to the next level? Dev10 provides a path for individuals who have a foundation in technical skills or professional experience and are eager to continue growing.  Whether you’ve earned a technical degree, gained hands-on programming experience, or worked professionally in industries like finance, healthcare, or insurance – Dev10 is your opportunity to upskill and launch a career in Software Development.     Dev10 provides a pathway for motivated learners to gain real-world experience while developing technical skills through immersive training. Whether you're growing your existing programming knowledge or starting to build those skills for the first time, Dev10 equips you with the tools to succeed. You'll train in technologies including Java, IntelliJ, MySQL, Spring, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, REST, and React.     Now hiring for our  Software Developer  cohort startingin  January   2027.   To apply, please submit a formal application through our website:  Dev10 Apply Here       What We Require       Willingness to relocate anywhere in the continental United States   Dev10 cannot provide or support any type of employment visa or work authorization paperwork, including OPT, CPT, EAD, H-1B, or TN. The only exceptions are for Asylees, Refugees, and TPS.   Bachelor's degree   Programming experience (6+ months) shown on your resume from academic coursework, personal projects, or professional work. You must have programmed within the last 3 months.   Plus one of the following, clearly listed on your resume:     A recent STEM degree (e.g., Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline)   OR 12+ months of professional work experience in finance, healthcare, banking, insurance, hospitality, aviation, or tech, with no more than a 12-month gap since you last held that professional role         What We Look For       Passion for learning and interest in Software Development    Strong logic and reasoning skills    Clear communication and collaboration abilities    Team-oriented mindset        What We Offer       Paid training (3-4 months) to build technical skills needed from the ground up – $600/week    Mentorship and instruction from Senior Engineers in an immersive, hands-on environment    $2,500 relocation assistance    Two years of client project experience    Hourly pay rate of $24.04 (~$50k annually) or $28.85 (~$60k annually) depending on assigned location    Dev10 Manager to help you navigate corporate culture and support your growth    Comprehensive benefits: health, vision, dental, 401(k), and paid time off        Curious if a career in Software Development is right for you?   Let’s explore this career path together!     To apply, please submit a formal application through our website:  Dev10 Apply Here     Please note: Applications submitted through this job posting will not be reviewed. You must apply via our site.       For more information on Dev10, check out our website at http://www.dev-10.com/

skills.label: C#
skills.source: Job Summary   The Actuarial Software Engineer II is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining actuarial calculation software within modern, scalable .NET-based systems. This role blends actuarial logic, strong software engineering practices, and insurance product knowledge to build accurate, performant, and maintainable calculation engines and APIs used across sales and illustration platforms. The engineer will collaborate closely with actuarial, engineering, and product teams in India and the US to deliver high-quality, compliant insurance solutions. Key Responsibilities D esign and develop modules using C# and .NET. Translate actuarial specifications into robust, testable software components. Build and enhance APIs and calculation services for illustration and quoting platforms. Ensure accuracy and performance of actuarial calculations. Apply OOP principles and industry best practices. Write unit tests and support automated testing for calculation integrity. Debug and troubleshoot calculation and system issues. Collaborate with teams across actuarial, product, QA, and engineering. Produce documentation for technical and actuarial processes. Provide accurate estimates and take ownership of deliverables. Participate in Agile ceremonies and continuous improvement activities. Required Qualifications 3+ years of professional software development experience. Strong proficiency in C# and the .NET ecosystem. Experience with ASP.NET/.NET Core, Web APIs, and service-oriented architecture. Solid understanding of OOP, SOLID principles, and design patterns. Experience with SQL databases (SQL Server preferred): query optimization, data modeling, performance. Ability to interpret and validate financial/actuarial calculations. Hands-on experience with Excel for validating calculation logic. Familiarity with Agile/Scrum development. Experience using Git/Azure DevOps, JIRA, or similar tools. Strong debugging, problem-solving, and analytical skills. Ability to bridge actuarial logic and software engineering. High ownership and accountability for assigned work. Comfort working in distributed India–US teams. Strong attention to detail, especially around financial accuracy. Willingness to continuously learn insurance domain knowledge and modern practices. Pr eferred Qualifications (if any) Experience building or supporting insurance illustration or actuarial systems. Exposure to annuity, life insurance, or retirement products. Experience with Entity Framework or similar ORMs. Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines. Familiarity with performance optimization techniques (caching, async processing). Basic understanding of application security and data protection best practices. Certifications (if any) Not required, but certifications in .NET, cloud platforms, or actuarial systems are a plus. r

skills.source: Job Summary We are seeking a Full Stack Java Developer to support and enhance enterprise investment servicing applications. The role focuses on developing Java-based solutions, building and optimizing Oracle database components, designing ETL workflows, and supporting critical data integrations across investment operations. The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience in Java development, SQL, data processing, and scripting, along with an interest in financial services and investment management environments. Key Responsibilities •    Design, develop, and maintain Java applications and JSP-based components supporting investment operations. •    Build and optimize Oracle SQL, PL/SQL, and stored procedures for high-volume data processing. •    Develop and maintain ETL workflows to integrate internal and external data sources. •    Collaborate with business and technical stakeholders to support investment servicing processes and data requirements. •    Develop automation and operational tools using Python or other scripting languages. •    Troubleshoot production issues and improve application performance, reliability, and scalability. •    Participate in code reviews, testing, and deployment activities while promoting engineering best practices. •    Support data integration and processing activities across enterprise investment servicing applications. Required Qualifications •    Strong hands-on experience in Java development. •    Experience with Java 21 and JSP-based application development. •    Hands-on SQL development experience, preferably with Oracle databases and stored procedures. •    Experience with Oracle SQL and PL/SQL. •    Experience designing and implementing ETL workflows. •    Scripting experience, preferably with Python. •    Experience working with data-intensive applications and integrations. •    Strong problem-solving and communication skills. Preferred Qualifications •    Exposure to financial services, investment management, or asset management environments. •    Familiarity with managed accounts, securities, equities, fixed income, holdings, positions, or tax lots. •    Experience working with market data providers such as Bloomberg or ICE Pricing. •    Experience supporting enterprise-scale data processing and reporting solutions.

evidence.text: Interviewed 500+ engineering candidates over 3 years with a standardized technical program and scoring rubrics for Java, Python and cloud teams.

skills.label: Python
skills.source: Location:   Onsite 3 days, Sunnyvale, CA   Salary Range:   Up to $95/hr on W2   Introduction   We are seeking a talented and experienced Embedded Software Engineer to design and deploy high-performance computer vision and machine learning pipelines directly onto resource-constrained edge hardware. Join our team and collaborate across software and hardware teams to bridge low-level camera sensor subsystems with on-device neural processing units (NPUs).   Required Skills & Qualifications     Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.   Proficiency in Python, and C and C++ for low-level software development and optimization.   Experience with machine learning frameworks optimized for edge deployment, such as TensorFlow Lite, ONNX Runtime, or PyTorch Edge.   Familiarity with the Android platform stack, specifically regarding multimedia or camera subsystem integration.   Solid understanding of computer vision fundamentals, digital signal processing (DSP), or basic camera architectures.   Previous AI experience.   Prior work experience at client or in client's Industry.     Applicants must be able to work directly for Artech on W2.   Preferred Skills & Qualifications     Hands-on experience developing within the Android camera framework to control, process, route, and transform real-time image streams.   Experience with model optimization techniques such as quantization, pruning, and hardware-specific compilation for NPUs, GPUs, or DSPs.   Background in developing low-latency algorithms for real-time edge applications (e.g., biometric verification, image restoration, or on-device language processing).     Day-to-Day Responsibilities     Design and deploy high-performance computer vision and machine learning pipelines directly onto resource-constrained edge hardware.   Optimize concurrent ML workloads to maximize throughput and minimize latency when running multiple edge-AI features simultaneously.   Integrate edge-AI algorithms seamlessly within the Android camera framework and multimedia subsystems.   Collaborate across software and hardware teams to bridge low-level camera sensor subsystems with on-device neural processing units (NPUs).   Profile and optimize memory footprint, power consumption, and execution timing to meet strict on-device performance constraints.     Company Benefits & Culture     Competitive salary and benefits package.   Opportunities for professional growth and development.   Collaborative and innovative work environment.     For immediate consideration please click APPLY to begin the screening process with Alex. Share your resume at aditya.singh3@artech.com
