skills.label: Python
skills.source: Ampcus Inc. is a certified global provider of a broad range of Technology and Business consulting services. We are in search of a highly motivated candidate to join our talented Team.      Job Title:  AI Engineer (GenAI & Agentic Systems).   Location:  Chantilly, VA.         Job Description:     The AI Engineer (GenAI & Agentic Systems) designs, prototypes, and builds generative AI and agentbased automations for knowledge work, decision support, and business workflows, and evaluates AI platforms and AI features embedded in 3rd party products.   This role experiments with and develops POCs/MVPs with large language models (LLMs), small language models (SLMs), retrievalaugmented generation (RAG), and agentic AI patterns.     Key Responsibilities:     GenAI POC and MVP Development     Design and implement GenAIpowered automations using LLMs/SLMs, tools, and agents.       Inference Pipelines for GenAI     Design and build GenAI inference pipelines that:   Accept structured and unstructured inputs.   Apply prompt templates and system instructions.   Invoke LLMs and tools.   Postprocess outputs into reliable, auditable results.   Support realtime, batch, and asynchronous inference patterns.       Prompt Engineering & Feature Engineering (Data)     Design and test prompt templates for data.   Implement data feature engineering for GenAI.       Agentic Architecture & Tool Integration     Design and prototype/develop agentic automations that decompose tasks, plan and reason oversteps, invoke tools and APIs, and handle errors and retries.   Integrate agents with AI platform and other source APIs.   Apply guardrails to control agent autonomy, cost, and risk.       Evaluation of SaaS / COTS GenAI Capabilities     Technically evaluate GenAI and agentic features embedded in thirdparty SaaS/COTS products, including:   LLM, SLM usage patterns and limitations.   Prompt and agent customization options.   API accessibility and automation readiness.   Observability and audit controls.   Provide technical input to architecture, procurement, and governance decisions.         Required Qualifications:     Technical Skills     Strong proficiency in Python and APIbased service development.   Handson experience with LLMs, SLMs, RAG, prompt engineering, and Agentic AI frameworks or patterns.   Experience building inference pipelines for GenAI.   Strong understanding of APIfirst and eventdriven architectures.   Experience integrating AI services with enterprise systems and SaaS platforms.       Conceptual & System Skills     Deep understanding of GenAI inference vs traditional deterministic systems, promptcentric and contextcentric design, and agent autonomy vs control tradeoffs.   Ability to translate experimentation into reliable, automated AI systems.   Strong collaboration skills across engineering, product, data, and governance teams.         Preferred Qualifications:     Experience building and maintaining GenAI systems in enterprise or regulated environments.   Familiarity with:     Vector databases and document retrieval systems.   Cost and latency optimization for LLMs and SLMs.   Monitoring and evaluation of GenAI outputs.       Experience assessing vendorprovided GenAI platforms and features.   Exposure to AI risk management or responsible AI practices.               Ampcus is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veterans or individuals with disabilities.

skills.label: Python
skills.source: Ampcus Inc. is a certified global provider of a broad range of Technology and Business consulting services. We are in search of a highly motivated candidate to join our talented Team.      Job Title:  Data Analyst     Location(s):  Reston, VA       Description:   The Data Analyst uses a variety of tools to assist in data extraction, analysis, and reporting. With strong foundational skills in SQL, they will work with datasets from a variety of sources, write complex queries to join disparate data, and collaborate with the larger Enterprise Business Intelligence team to provide meaningful and actionable insights that solve business challenges across the organization. Strong analytical and detail-oriented thinking is required along with a solid understanding of relational databases.      A Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, or other technically-intensive field;   Proficiency in constructing and interpreting complex SQL queries including joins, pivots, aggregation, basic case/if logic, common table expressions (CTEs), and window functions;   Understanding of and exposure to data visualization tools like Tableau and Power BI;   Familiarity with data exploration and basic statistical analysis including hypothesis testing;   Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, creativity in solving problems, strong attention to detail and accuracy, and the ability to perform with limited guidance;   Ability to communicate complex insights to teammates and non-technical stakeholders.     In addition, a preferred candidate will possess:     Experience in working with Snowflake databases;   Basic proficiency with manipulating data in R and/or Python;   Familiarity with basic machine learning concepts (i.e. multivariate regression) including how to perform and interpret them.     Skills:     SQL and any other Database Systems such as Snowflake, Writing Queries, Pivot, CTE, Analytical.   Proficiency in constructing and interpreting complex SQL queries including joins, pivots.     Education:     Bachelors in IT, Data Science or any relevant Technical fiel.         Ampcus is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identify, national origin, age, protected veterans or individuals with disabilities.

practices and architectural decisions.    ·          Analyze complex system logs and large datasets to troubleshoot issues and optimize application performance.         Minimum qualifications:    ·          Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.    ·          Experience in full-stack software development with a strong focus on Java. Java Cucumber.    ·          Familiarity with large-scale data analytics, logging, and monitoring tools (e.g., BigQuery, Splunk).    ·          Experience or familiarity with the .NET framework.    ·          Proven ability to navigate and engineer solutions within complex, multi-application environments and distributed systems.    ·          Exceptional knowledge transfer skills, with a track record of effectively mentoring peers and documenting complex technical domains.

In this role, you will navigate a complex, multi-application ecosystem, requiring a deep understanding of architectural dependencies and modern engineering practices. You will act as a catalyst for innovation by integrating AI-driven tools into the daily engineering workflow to enhance design, accelerate development, and streamline code reviews. We value engineers who are not only technically proficient but also passionate about knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.         Responsibilities    ·          Design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and improve software across the entire stack.    ·          Manage and optimize database interactions across both SQL and MongoDB environments.    ·          Implement and maintain rigorous testing standards utilizing modern frameworks (e.g., Cucumber) to ensure high code quality and reliability.    ·          Leverage AI-assisted tooling to optimize the software development lifecycle, from initial architecture design to comprehensive peer reviews.    ·          Actively facilitate knowledge transfer across the engineering organization, ensuring team members are aligned on best practices and architectural decisions.    ·          Analyze complex system logs and large datasets to troubleshoot issues and optimize application performance.         Minimum qualifications:    ·          Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.    ·          Experience in full-stack software development with a strong focus on Java.    ·          Hands-on experience developing user interfaces using modern front-end frameworks, specifically Angular and React.    ·          Experience designing and interacting with relational and NoSQL databases, including SQL and MongoDB.    ·          Experience with version control systems and collaborative development using GitHub.    ·          Practical experience utilizing AI tools to assist with software design, active development, and pull request (PR) reviews.         Preferred qualifications:    ·          Experience writing automated tests using frameworks such as Ruby and Java Cucumber.    ·          Familiarity with large-scale data analytics, logging, and monitoring tools (e.g., BigQuery, Splunk).    ·          Experience or familiarity with the .NET framework.    ·          Proven ability to navigate and engineer solutions within complex, multi-application environments and distributed systems.    ·          Exceptional knowledge transfer skills, with a track record of effectively mentoring peers and documenting complex technical domains.

evidence.text: Fidelity pipeline monitoring and audit trails for encrypted insurance transfer compliance.

skills.label: Python
skills.source: Job Title:  Full Stack Data Engineer   Location: Tampa FL   Duration:  6 months (Extendable)   Pay Range: $45-48/Hour on W2/C2C (All Inclusive)  Request ID: 112198-1     Position Summary:  We are seeking a versatile and skilled Full Stack Data Engineer with a strong background in Python, LangChain & LangGraph, RAG, Agentic AI, DevOps, AI Data and UI development using React and TypeScript. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing and implementing data pipelines, AI-driven solutions, and front-end interfaces, alongside streamlining deployment and operational processes through DevOps practices. This role demands a combination of data engineering expertise, AI knowledge, and full stack development skills to deliver scalable and efficient solutions.  Key Responsibilities:  Develop, maintain, and optimize scalable data pipelines for ingestion, transformation, and analysis using Python.  Design and implement AI and machine learning models to derive insights and automate processes.  Build responsive and intuitive user interfaces using React and TypeScript to visualize data and AI outputs.  Implement DevOps practices including CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, and automated testing to ensure reliable deployment.  Collaborate with cross-functional teams including data scientists, product managers, and developers to deliver end-to-end data solutions.  Monitor performance, troubleshoot issues, and ensure the scalability and security of data and application systems.  Stay up-to-date with emerging technologies and best practices in data engineering, AI, front-end development, and DevOps      Skills: Digital : Python~Digital : ReactJS~Next JS  Experience Required: 6-8

evidence.text: Interviewed 500+ engineering candidates over 3 years with a standardized technical program and scoring rubrics for Java, Python and cloud teams.

skills.source: Location: Remote US   Preferred: Onsite (hybrid) - CA-MPK   Salary Range: $90 - $99/hr.   Introduction   We are seeking a Growth Marketing Engineer to provide dedicated engineering support for Subscriptions consumer marketing initiatives. This role involves developing and maintaining the technical infrastructure supporting acquisition and retention campaigns as marketing investments expand from exploratory testing to multi-million-dollar programs. It is project-based and campaign-driven, requiring close collaboration with marketing leads and existing engineering stakeholders.   Required Skills & Qualifications     Deep Linking and Mobile Attribution: Expertise in developing and managing campaign links across web and mobile applications.   SQL and Data Pipelines: Proficiency in constructing audience segmentation tables from complex behavioral datasets.   Advertising Platform Integration: Proficiency with conversion pixels, custom audience integrations, and campaign tracking architectures.   Backend or Full-Stack Engineering: Demonstrated skill in Python alongside Hack/PHP, Java, or JavaScript.   A/B Testing and Experimentation Frameworks: Experience in designing, executing, and evaluating growth experiments.   Prior work experience at client or in client's Industry.     Applicants must be able to work directly for Artech on W2.   Preferred Skills & Qualifications     Experience with targeted marketing email initiatives.   Experience in constructing custom audience data tables derived from cross-app user behavioral metrics.   Experience executing end-to-end growth and promotional experimentation.     Day-to-Day Responsibilities     Develop and maintain deep links for paid campaigns, influencer attribution, referrals, and off-platform channels.   Implement and maintain conversion tracking mechanisms within user onboarding flows.   Support targeted marketing email initiatives by mapping user behavioral signals into defined audience parameters.     Company Benefits & Culture     Collaborative and innovative work environment.   Opportunities for professional development and growth.   Flexible work arrangements.     For immediate consideration please click APPLY to begin the screening process with Alex.  You can share your resumes at satyam.singh@artech.com

skills.source: Ampcus Inc. is a certified global provider of a broad range of Technology and Business consulting services. We are in search of a highly motivated candidate to join our talented Team.   Job Title : Software Dev Engineer - Software Dev Engineer IV     Job Location:  Dallas, TX.   Job Description:   Design, develop, implement, test, document and deliver large-scale, multi-tiered, distributed software applications, tools, systems and services using multi-threaded programming, distributed programming in Java, Python, Typescript, React, SQL, Object Oriented design and design patterns. Assist in gathering and analyzing business and functional requirements, and translate requirements into technical specifications for robust, scalable, supportable solutions that work well within the overall system architecture. Own delivery of entire piece of system or application, and serve as technical lead on complex projects using best practice engineering standards. Produce comprehensive, usable software documentation. Participate in a 24x7 on-call support rotation and travel for onsite troubleshooting or project launch.   Qualifications:     MS in Computer Science, Computer or Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field plus one year of experience in the job offered or related occupations of Software Engineer, Software Developer, or related.   Experience in the job offered or related occupation must involve multi-threaded programming and distributed programming in Java, Python, Typescript, React.   Experience must also involve JDBC, SQL, and Object Oriented design and design patterns.   Requires experience using AI coding tools, and with MCP, building agents using any of the agent frameworks.   Requires availability for travel and 24x7 on-call support rotation.   Employer will accept Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer or Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field plus five years of progressively responsible experience in the specialty as equivalent to the Master's degree.       Ampcus is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veterans or individuals with disabilities.

skills.label: Python
skills.source: Introduction   Join our diverse global team to design and develop embedded software in areas related to cloud-based computing, ad-hoc computing, and embedded platforms. This role focuses on the Body Control Module, directly impacting vehicle safety, user experience, and electrification readiness.   Required Skills & Qualifications     Experience in the full lifecycle of embedded software development for safety-critical automotive systems.   Strong understanding of hardware-software interaction, real-time constraints, and communication protocols (CAN/LIN).   Proficient in MATLAB/Simulink (including Stateflow) for modeling, designing, and simulating embedded control algorithms.   Ability to write clean, efficient, and standards-compliant code for embedded automotive applications, including scripting for automation.   Proficiency in writing and debugging C/C++ code for real-time, resource-constrained embedded targets, including implementing AUTOSAR software components.   Prior work experience in the automotive industry.     Applicants must be able to work directly for Artech on W2.   Preferred Skills & Qualifications     Master's Degree in a relevant field.   Experience with DaVinci Developer for AUTOSAR configuration and integration.   Familiarity with ISO 26262 (Functional Safety), ASPICE, and AUTOSAR standards.     Day-to-Day Responsibilities     Design, develop, and implement embedded control systems for Body Control Modules (BCM).   Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to capture system-level requirements and translate them into detailed specifications.   Lead test strategy design and execution, including MIL, SIL, and HIL simulations, plus unit/integration testing.   Conduct root cause analysis of defects and implement robust fixes.   Identify development bottlenecks and implement Python-based automation scripts and reusable model templates.     For immediate consideration please click APPLY to begin the screening process with Alex.

skills.source: Our client is currently seeking a Data Analyst II 			 The CX Insights and Engagement Team designs and implements a best-in-class Voice of the Customer (VOC) program to drive customer-centric decision-making. This role requires strong communication, interpersonal, presentation, financial/analytical, and problem-solving skills. The ideal candidate has a proven track record in leading data-driven customer experience programs and implementing enterprise technology solutions. They thrive in an environment that promotes customer-centricity, teamwork, and accountability. As part of a dynamic and growing team, you will generate insights and customer experience solutions that impact the entire Consumer CX Organization. What will you do: Design, build, and implement VOC data flow, data validation, and system integrations in collaboration with GTS, AI&D, vendors, business teams, and development teams. Drive agile project management, including creating user stories in Jira, leading grooming sessions, and ensuring successful sprint execution. Utilize expertise with VOC vendors such as Qualtrics, Medallia, and other customer experience platforms to design, analyze, and optimize VOC programs. Partner with cross-functional teams to implement technology solutions that enhance customer insights and improve overall experience. Ensure seamless integration of VOC systems with enterprise data architecture to support data-driven decision-making and actionable insights. Manage data ingestion processes, ensuring seamless integration across multiple systems. Lead system integrations, APIs, and real-time payload creation to optimize VOC programs. What We’re Looking For: Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience. Six or more years of relevant experience in data engineering, system integration, and VOC program implementation. Proficiency in SQL to extract, manipulate, and analyze large datasets. Hands-on experience with system integrations, data engineering, and data migration, with a solid understanding of data architecture across multiple systems. Ideally, You Will Also Have: A background in marketing, computer science, business transformation, data science, or customer experience in a business, agency, or consulting environment. Experience developing and automating data analytics and conducting ad-hoc analyses. Strong analytical skills with a proven ability to meet and exceed business objectives. A high level of accountability and ownership. The ability to build strong relationships with business partners, manage multiple projects simultaneously, and deliver results on time.

skills.source: Role: Full Stack Engineer Level II  Location: Riverwoods, IL/Remote (Must align with Central Time business hours)  Contract: 6 Months    Position Overview  Capital One's Legacy Discover API Management team is seeking an experienced Drupal / Acquia Cloud Developer to support the development, maintenance, and modernization of its external developer portal, hosted on Acquia Cloud and built on Drupal.  The primary focus of this role is supporting the migration of the existing portal from Drupal 10 to Drupal 11, maintaining custom Drupal modules, addressing vulnerabilities, applying patches, and resolving application issues. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with both Drupal development and the Acquia Cloud platform, along with strong backend development capabilities.    Key Responsibilities  •    Support the migration and upgrade of the external developer portal from Drupal 10 to Drupal 11.  •    Develop, maintain, and troubleshoot Drupal-based applications hosted on Acquia Cloud.  •    Manage and enhance custom Drupal modules and contributed modules.  •    Support backend development, including customizations and PHP-based Drupal coding as required.  •    Perform vulnerability remediation, security patching, bug fixes, and routine application maintenance.  •    Participate in Agile sprint planning, feature development, and maintenance activities.  •    Troubleshoot migration issues and help ensure the portal remains stable and available throughout the upgrade.  •    Support planned application updates and maintenance activities outside regular business hours when required.  •    Collaborate with existing engineers, participate in knowledge sharing, and contribute to technical documentation.  •    Follow established change management and deployment procedures to minimize disruption to business operations.    Required Qualifications  •    Hands-on experience developing and maintaining applications using Drupal.  •    Practical experience working with the Acquia Cloud platform.  •    Recent experience with modern Drupal versions, preferably Drupal 10 or Drupal 11.  •    Direct experience upgrading or migrating Drupal applications, particularly from Drupal 10 to Drupal 11.  •    Strong backend development skills and experience working with Drupal customizations.  •    Experience troubleshooting application issues, applying patches, and maintaining production websites.  •    Experience with vulnerability remediation, security patching, and application maintenance.  •    Ability to work independently while collaborating with a distributed engineering team.  •    Availability to work during the team's core Central Time business hours.  •    Flexibility to support occasional planned off-hours maintenance.    Preferred Qualifications  •    Experience with PHP and custom Drupal module development.  •    Familiarity with Drupal contributed modules and customized Drupal environments.  •    Experience with Agile development practices, sprint-based delivery, and technical documentation.  •    Acquia Cloud certifications are a plus but are not mandatory.    Project Details and Working Expectations  •    Primary initiative: Support the Drupal 10-to-Drupal 11 migration, with a target deadline in December.  •    Application environment: The portal includes approximately 20 custom Drupal modules and 40 contributed modules.  •    Work arrangement: Fully remote; candidates may be located anywhere in the U.S. and do not need to report to the Riverwoods, Illinois office.  •    Working hours: Must align with the team's Central Time business hours.  •    Off-hours maintenance: Occasional maintenance may be required, typically within a late-evening or overnight window, approximately 9:00 PM to 2:00–3:00 AM, depending on the change. The team anticipates fewer than five such events over the six-month contract, potentially fewer. Weekend work may be avoidable.  •    Schedule flexibility: When off-hours maintenance is required, the engineer may coordinate adjusted working hours during the week. Overtime is not expected.  •    Contract term: Six months, with no guarantee of extension.

skills.source: Job Description:   Job Title: Informatics Data Analyst       Location: 900 S. Fremont Ave., Alhambra, CA, 91803       Duration: 12-month contract       Pay Rate: $39/hr. on W2.  Job ID: 26-28488  Only USC and GC     Position Description:       An Informatics Data Analyst works independently to document external data acquisition policies and procedures as well as interface with other business units to define and document data needs and ad-hoc analysis requirements; identify business practice workflow and process issues and concerns; provide leadership and guidance to define system and process requirements that will optimize system performance and technology utilization by system users; and design information systems and technologies that ensure access and transparency. The Informatics Data Analyst will develop, implement, organize, and maintain information and reports to document operational and financial performance; collaborate with the quality team, administrators, etc., to design the ad hoc and other relevant routine reports; monitor the quality programs and make efforts to improve them; compile data from multiple sources and import the data into the relevant database; select appropriate tools and methods to maintain the existing programs that ensures there is appropriate transfer of data and that all the reports are documented well to increase the efficiency; assist with analysis of external data definitions documentation and mapping process; perform a Quality Assurance function for the data integration processes and repository metrics; collaborate with other staff to document data needs and metric definitions; validate data load processes and the quality of the data loaded into data repositories; maintain, store, map and analyze data in compliance with policies and procedures; coordinate with LAN and IT Security teams in order to utilize PGP encryption software and File Transfer Protocols; and use software such as SAS, Access, and Excel to provide data mapping for integration using Business Objects, and SQL.       Skills Required:        The Informatics Data Analyst will possess knowledge and experience in basic statistical concepts; identifying the trends, business opportunities, and relevant issues; commonly-used demographics and databases; definitions of fields and how data is entered and processed; data mining/intelligence; statistically-valid analysis and measurement methodologies; packaging data – infographics and other data display techniques, and report design options; data interpretation and validation; Ad Hoc analysis/performance evaluation principles; common demographic data bases; SQL coding and report services; data warehouse design; web-based application design; PC skills (e.g. Client Office, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, SAS, Access and Excel); working independently as well as a leadership role in creating process documentation and interfacing with other team members to obtain this information; detailed-oriented; excellent interpersonal, oral and written communication skills; ability to handle multiple tasks; and problem solving and troubleshooting skills.       Additional Skills Required:        California Resident Candidates Only. Additional live scan requirements must be completed for the Department. Automation testing is a functional software testing technique that ensures our products are of high quality and reliable.       In this role...    You will do roughly 85% automation and 15% manual testing    You will develop and execute formal Test plans, procedures and scenarios for automated testing to ensure quality of software applications. Reviews and assesses test coverage to ensure thorough quality review.    You will plan tests, writes test cases/scripts, develops & executes automated test cases.    You will perform various Test Types including smoke, application, functional and regression testing. You will document and track test results, defects, ROI and other quality metrics. Enters problems and issues into system and participates in analysis and resolution.    You will develop and implement quality standards and best practices, contributing ideas and effort toward continuous improvement.    Delivers quality process training to technical staff and acts as an internal quality consultant to advise or influence business or technical partners. Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively with team members.    Excellent analytical, verbal and written communication skills

skills.source: Job Description:   Job Title:  Software Engineer 4   Location:  San Antonio, TX     Duration:  12-month contract   Job ID:  #26-32840      Position Summary:     Designs, develops, tests, and maintains software programs based on customer requirements, using development standards and software development lifecycle process.    Daily tasks may include requirements analysis, design, planning, programming, testing, documentation, error/exception handling, performance improvements and business process implementation.    Tasks may also include analysis, research and recommendations for process implementation, performance and technology improvements.    Demonstrates technical expertise through maintaining primary technical programming skills for assigned job, developing new skills as required, developing guidelines and standards, and demonstrating best practices and leadership.         Tasks and Responsibilities:     Designs, develops, tests, and maintains software solutions to meet customer requirements. Tasks required to complete this often include requirements analysis, documentation, error/exception handling, business process implementation, performance analysis/improvements and technology research.   Maintain technical skills through hands-on experience, independent research, training and/or conferences.   Strong understanding of secure cloud technologies.   Collaborates with leadership, product owners, architects, and business liaison to understand requirements   Maintains and enhances existing system design through strong understanding of architecture and test-driven development skills   Research and develop new technologies to enhance current and future design, security and system performance   Strong understanding of Web Services and SOAP/REST integrations of third-party and remote systems   Expert knowledge in optimizing SQL relational operations including direct query, caching mechanisms, read/write clustering, etc.   Strong understanding of DevOps best practices, Code Repository Branching/Merging, and system integrations   Expert knowledge of code implementation, and upgrades of platform infrastructures   Good understanding of the configuration and management of Apache Tomcat for hosting Java Web Applications   Knowledge of SSL and Encryption methodologies, as well as an understanding of SSL implementations   Good understanding of secure cloud technologies   Ability to assist in the communication with customers, requirements gathering, design, analysis, documentation, and development of project assignments.   Technical skills necessary for developing architectural designs from gathered requirements.   Ability to develop full-stack application solutions.   Self-managed and motivated to maintain project deliverables and timelines.   Technical knowledge to identify gaps and complications in project designs.   Ability to professionally negotiate and challenge decisions, when necessary, to ensure project success.   Participate in Agile development methodology and ceremonies.   Performs other duties as assigned.         Minimum Qualifications:     Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Electrical Engineering from an accredited university OR Relevant technical programming experience   Mid-level experience in web-based IT solutions:   Demonstrates at least two or more primary technical skill area listed here: Java and/or web programming, including JSP, Servlets, JDBC, web services, mobile, Angular, React, React Native, VueJS, JSON and HTML web development, Relational database design and application development (i.e., Oracle, DB2, etc.), including SQL queries, PL/SQL, Oracle APEX, DB2, etc., and Hands-on developer application server experience, including Apache Tomcat, WebSphere Application Server or other (preferred)   Proficient in using Github, including branching and merging.   Demonstrated ability to create and execute unit tests.   Object-oriented programming experience   Mid-level experience with one or more development methodologies (i.e., waterfall, Agile, Rational Unified Process – RUP, etc.)   Demonstrates critical thinking problem solving skills on a semi-routing basis for creative and innovative solutions.   Demonstrates decision-making and communication skills to address customer issues, as well as analyze and clarify a new project assignment.   Ability to work well in a team environment.   Demonstrates technical writing skills   Demonstrates customer service and situation-appropriate, professional customer communication   Demonstrates time management and multi-tasking skills.   Independent thinking skills and ability to self-manage workload. Responsibilities are usually project oriented with general guidelines and references available.   Ability to work independently on project assignments, including communication with customers, requirements gathering, design, analysis, documentation, and development.   Understanding of APIs and modern technology architecture .         Preferred Qualifications:     Java Developer Certification(s)   Oracle or DB2 Certification(s)   Experience with Oracle AEM integrations.   Experience with Oracle Visual Builder   Professional Experience in web-based IT solutions   Experience in mobile responsive Web design   Solid knowledge of OWASP and familiarity with web application vulnerabilities.   Demonstrates technical writing skills   Demonstrates customer service and situation-appropriate, professional customer communication   Demonstrates time management and multi-tasking skills.   Experience with CI/CD pipeline configurations and management   Working knowledge of source control software (SVN or Git), build and deployment tools (Maven, Jenkins, Gradle)   Sharp troubleshooting skills and real-world systems deployment experience.         Regards,   Simran Bharti | Core Staffing   Technical Recruiter   Cell: 512.641.8764   Email:   Simran.Bharti@artech.com     LinkedIn:  www.linkedin.com/in/simran-bharti-870216211   360 Mt. Kemble Avenue, Suite 2000, Morristown, NJ 07960    Website:  www.artech.com

skills.source: Spotlight call- Wednesday, 8/19/26 at 9:30am- please do not submit any candidates until after the call has taken place.    Location: Maine- Preferred as the team meets in the Westbrook, ME office for 1-day "workshops" when the work requires it. NOT a hybrid role- only need to be in the office for "workshop" day.    The manager will also review candidates who are in the EST time zone.    This team is responsible for testing the quality, reliability, and stability of *** Applications and Systems. This includes both Cloud and on-prem applications. This group is generally more technical looking at more key projects, key initiatives, high profile services for *** and making sure they are built with quality and performing. Automation testing is a functional software testing technique that ensures our products are of high quality and reliable.  In this role...  You will do roughly 85% automation and 15% manual testing  You will develop and execute formal Test plans, procedures and scenarios for automated testing to ensure quality of software applications. Reviews and assesses test coverage to ensure thorough quality review.  You will plan tests, writes test cases/scripts, develops & executes automated test cases.  You will perform various Test Types including smoke, application, functional and regression testing. Including appropriate level of testing to ensure that systems or applications are tested effectively prior to implementation.  You will document and track test results, defects, ROI and other quality metrics. Enters problems and issues into system and participates in analysis and resolution.  You will develop and implement quality standards and best practices, contributing ideas and effort toward continuous improvement.  Delivers quality process training to technical staff and acts as an internal quality consultant to advise or influence business or technical partners.  What you will need to succeed...  1-3+ years of QE Automation testing experience  Coding skills in Java are required for this (understand how to work with Java)  SQL skills are required  Cucumber experience is needed  Kotlin would be nice to have  Bachelors degree or equivalent combination of education and experience  Excellent problem-solving abilities.  Ability to multi-task, prioritize and meet deadlines.  Excellent verbal and written communication skills.  Drive and initiative.  Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively with team members.  Excellent analytical, verbal and written communication skills

evidence.text: Delivered Fortune 500 Java systems for Fidelity, British Telecom and T-Mobile over 3 years spanning secure insurance exchange, telecom commerce and an AWS operations platform for 3K employees.

This includes the      Liquidity Coverage Ratio (LCR) and related public disclosures, the Net Stable      Funding Ratio (NSFR), and the FR 2052a Complex Institution Liquidity      Monitoring Report. The team also develops tools to help our business      partners analyze the impact of business decisions. In addition, we      collaborate with internal and external partners on ongoing examinations      and audits of liquidity practices. As a Regulatory Reporting Analyst,      you will support the daily production, validation, control, and submission      processes for U.S. liquidity regulatory reporting. You will take primary      responsibility for FR 2052a reporting while providing additional support      for the LCR and NSFR reporting processes. This role requires strong      analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to independently      manage daily production activities within strict regulatory deadlines      while partnering cross-functionally with Treasury, Finance, Risk, Data,      and Technology teams.         Responsibilities    Execute daily FR 2052a production, validation, and      regulatory submission activities in accordance with established procedures      and strict reporting deadlines. Perform detailed variance analysis, reconciliations,      and quality reviews to ensure reporting completeness, accuracy, and      compliance. Utilize SQL to analyze large datasets, investigate      reporting anomalies, and identify root causes of data issues. Monitor reporting processes, data feeds, and system      interfaces; promptly identify, escalate, and track issues to ensure timely      and effective resolution. Support LCR and NSFR reporting processes, including      data validation, reconciliations, and reporting controls. Partner with Treasury, Finance, Risk, Data Management,      and Technology teams to resolve data discrepancies and implement reporting      enhancements. Maintain and enhance reporting procedures, control      documentation, governance evidence, and audit support materials. Participate in testing, implementation, and production      validation of regulatory reporting changes, system upgrades, and new      initiatives. Identify and implement automation opportunities to      improve reporting efficiency, reduce manual processes, and strengthen      operational controls. Develop comprehensive business requirements for      functional and nonfunctional enhancements supporting liquidity regulatory      reporting processes. Create and optimize SQL queries to analyze datasets of      varying complexity, develop analytical models, and interpret data from      multiple sources (databases, spreadsheets, and reporting systems).         Minimum Qualifications    Bachelor's degree. 2-5 years of related experience within a financial      institution (e.g., banking or broker-dealer businesses). Experience with liquidity regulatory reporting,      specifically FR 2052a, Liquidity Coverage Ratio (LCR), and Net Stable      Funding Ratio (NSFR). Experience working with SQL and Microsoft Excel to      analyze large datasets and run complex queries. Basic knowledge of finance and accounting principles.         Preferred Qualifications    Experience with AxiomSL ControllerView. Knowledge of U.S. GAAP and accounting policy. Hands-on experience implementing automation tools to      optimize reporting processes. Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with a      proven track record in data analysis and trend identification. Excellent documentation skills, with the ability to      create comprehensive business requirements, process documentation, and      analytical reports. Ability to navigate ambiguity, make informed decisions,      and thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with changing priorities.    Medical, dental, and vision insurance are available to qualified candidates who meet eligibility requirements.

evidence.text: Reduced reconciliation errors 90% by automating transaction matching, validation and exception reporting with SQL and Python.

skills.source: Job Title:  Graphics Software Engineer   Work Location:  San Diego, CA 92121 (100% onsite)   Duration of Assignment:  3+ Months   Pay Rate Range:  $60.00-$68.00/hr on W2     Job Description:   Top 5 Required Skills (These are not preferred skills. If the candidate does not have these required skills, they will be rejected completely)     1. Vulkan Graphics Programming  - Strong experience with Vulkan render pipelines, compute shaders, synchronization, descriptor sets, memory barriers, and GPU-driven rendering.   2. Modern C++ Performance Engineering  - Expert-level C++ for real-time systems, memory management, multithreading, SIMD-friendly data layouts, and low-latency rendering code.   3. Mobile GPU Optimization  - Deep understanding of mobile GPU architectures, especially tile-based rendering, bandwidth limits, cache behavior, thermal constraints, and power/performance tradeoffs.   4. GPU Compute and Shader Optimization  - Ability to optimize GLSL/SPIR-V compute and graphics shaders, including sorting, culling, binning, blending, prefix sums, compaction, and parallel data processing.   5. Graphics Performance Profiling and Debugging  - Experience identifying GPU bottlenecks using profiling tools, analyzing frame timing, shader occupancy, memory bandwidth, overdraw, synchronization stalls, and CPU/GPU overlap.     Required Technologies  - Vulkan  - C++17/C++20  - Android NDK  - GLSL or HLSL  - SPIR-V  - Qualcomm Adreno GPU architecture  - Snapdragon mobile platforms  - Qualcomm Snapdragon Profiler  - RenderDoc  - Android Studio / Android build tools  - CMake  - GPU compute shader math  - Real-time rendering pipelines     Required Education:   Required Years of Experience  Bachelor's degree in Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Software Engineering, or related field and 2+ years of Software Engineering, Hardware Engineering, Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Game Rendering, or related work experience.     Principal Duties and Responsibilities:  • Applies Graphics knowledge and experience to architect, design, implement, and verify the structure and performance of GPU hardware, drivers, features, applications, and tools.  • Writes code for features, drivers, and APIs using different languages (e.g., C, C++, perl, python) and ensures code will perform effectively on different platforms.  • Maintains comprehensive pre- and post-silicon tests using tools and methods in different environments (e.g., simulation, emulation, on-device) to verify performance and identify issues.  • Identifies deficiencies in designs and works with team members to develop solutions to improve designs.  • Collaborates with teams and external stakeholders to expose new features and functionality that align with needs and goals for implementation and customization.  • Writes detailed design documentation and feature descriptions for projects to guide developers and/or customers to use or implement software.     Job Overview   We are seeking a contractor Graphics Software Engineer to support development of real-time Gaussian Splatting–based rendering systems for avatar and XR applications running on-device (edge devices such as Android phones and AR glasses).  This role focuses on GPU optimization, memory-efficient data pipelines, and real-time Gaussian Splatting rendering under mobile constraints. The ideal candidate will be highly hands-on and able to quickly improve performance-critical systems deployed directly on hardware.   Key Responsibilities   1. Gaussian Splatting Rendering    Develop and optimize Dynamic Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) rendering pipelines       Improve performance of splat-based rendering, including sorting, data layout, and shader efficiency       Analyze and resolve issues such as:       Splat flickering and popping       Sorting inconsistencies       Precision differences between CPU and GPU    2. On-Device GPU Optimization (Android / Edge Devices)    Optimize Gaussian Splatting pipelines for mobile GPUs (e.g., Adreno) on Android       Ensure efficient execution under limited memory, bandwidth, and power constraints       Tune rendering for real-time performance on phones and AR glasses    3. Data Pipeline & Memory Efficiency    Design compact data representations for Gaussian Splatting frame data       Optimize CPU → GPU data transfers for real-time rendering       Eliminate intermediate processing and reduce runtime memory overhead    4. Shader Development & Rendering Pipeline Integration    Implement GPU shaders tailored to Gaussian Splatting data formats       Optimize shader input pathways for efficient on-device execution       Integrate rendering pipelines with motion, lighting systems.    5. Debugging & System Validation    Debug complex rendering issues in Gaussian Splatting pipelines       Investigate numerical precision issues and GPU/CPU inconsistencies       Validate rendering output against reference pipelines    6. Collaboration & Execution    Collaborate closely with XR, vision, and avatar teams       Contribute to on-device demos and prototype systems (phones / AR glasses)       Execute quickly on well-defined tasks with strong ownership of implementation      Required Qualifications      Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related field       Strong programming skills in C/C++       Experience with Android platform development       Experience with GPU programming (OpenGL ES, Vulkan, or similar)       Solid understanding of:       Real-time rendering pipelines       GPU memory management       Performance optimization on embedded systems      Preferred Qualifications      Direct experience with Gaussian Splatting / Relighting / Simulation       Experience building graphics systems on mobile or XR devices       Familiarity with Adreno GPU architecture       Experience optimizing for real-time constraints (latency, bandwidth, power)       Experience debugging rendering artifacts in GPU pipelines

skills.source: Job Title: Software Test Technician  Job ID: 37671966  Location: Minnetonka, MN 55305   (Hybrid)  Duration:12 months  Pay Rate: $45.00 - $50.00/hr. on W2     Job Description:  The responsibilities of this role are focused on developing and executing software tests in support of Monteris Medical’s software and integrated system releases. The Test Technician develops, executes, and maintains manual and automated test scripts and test cases to verify software against approved requirements and design specifications, working under the direction of the Manager, Software Engineering and V&V. This role applies hands-on application development and test automation skills- including C#, WPF, C++, and industry-standard automated test frameworks such as NUnit, Google Test, and JUnit - to support thorough, well-documented, and traceable testing of medical device software.     Primary Organization Responsibilities  Follows all applicable Monteris Quality System Standard Operating Procedures as well as various applicable FDA, ISO, CSA, and EU regulations and Guidance Documents. Will handle all matters using a high level of judgment, responsibility, and professionalism.  Develops, executes, and maintains automated test scripts and test tools using C#, WPF, and C++ to support software development and verification activities.  Executes manual and automated test protocols and test cases in accordance with approved test plans, requirements, and design specifications.  Builds and maintains automated test cases and test suites using NUnit, Google Test, JUnit, or other equivalent automated test frameworks.  Sets up, configures, and maintains test environments, hardware/software test benches, and laboratory equipment required for verification testing.  Records, documents, and reports test results, defects, and anomalies with clear, accurate, and traceable documentation.  Supports defect identification, logging, tracking, and retesting through resolution and closure.  Assists in the development and revision of test cases, test scripts, and test procedures in response to requirement and design changes.  Maintains traceability between requirements, test cases, and test results within Jama.  Supports automated test execution, monitoring, and reporting through Jenkins CI/CD pipelines.  Collaborates with software engineers, verification analysts, and quality personnel to ensure thorough and accurate test coverage.  Participates in the review of test protocols, test scripts, and test reports.  Supports troubleshooting and root-cause investigation of software defects identified during testing.  Supports testing of image processing and visualization features, including DICOM-based imaging workflows, as applicable to assigned projects.  Participates in the risk planning process as requested or required.  Supports audits, inspections, and regulatory submissions by ensuring test documentation is complete, accurate, and audit ready.  Performs other duties as requested or assigned.     Skills:  Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and root-cause investigation skills.  Solid understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC), software test methodologies, and software quality assurance principles.  Ability to read and interpret software requirements, design specifications, and test protocols.  Strong attention to detail with a commitment to accurate, thorough, and traceable documentation.  Good organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple test activities and deadlines.  Effective verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to clearly document and report defects and results.  Ability to work collaboratively with software engineers, verification and validation staff, and quality personnel.  Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, regulated development environment.  Willingness to learn new tools, frameworks, and imaging technologies as needed.  Ability to retain information on a confidential basis.     Education/Experience  Associate’s degree or technical certification in software engineering, computer science, engineering technology, or a related field required; Bachelor’s degree preferred.  Minimum of five (5) years of experience in software development and/or software testing.  Application development experience with C# and WPF.  Experience with C++ software development and/or test automation.  Hands-on experience with automated test frameworks such as NUnit, Google Test, JUnit, or comparable frameworks.  Experience executing software verification and validation activities, preferably within a regulated environment.  Experience with VTK/ITK and DICOM image processing and visualization is considered an asset.  Experience with requirements management tools such as Jama and automation orchestration tools such as Jenkins is considered an asset.

We are in search of a highly motivated candidate to join our talented Team.       Job Title:  Data Analyst 3   Location(s):  Richmond, VA   (Hybrid: 2–3 days onsite per week)       Job Summary  We are seeking a detail-oriented and technically proficient Data Analyst to support IT FinOps initiatives. This role is pivotal in analyzing, modeling, and forecasting financial data related to Azure cloud services and on-premises data center workloads. The ideal candidate combines financial acumen with strong data analytics skills to support strategic decision-making and cost optimization initiatives. Collaborate with the technical cloud team, I&O team, and finance stakeholders to align cost models with operational realities.   Support Azure migration planning by modeling server cost scenarios and forecasting reserve capacity needs.   Contribute to FinOps strategy development by providing insights on cost drivers and utilization patterns.     Required Qualifications     Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or related field.   Advanced proficiency in Power BI, including Power Query and DAX, Excel (advanced), and data visualization best practices.   Data modeling and data manipulation skills to maintain datasets from multiple, heterogeneous sources.   High familiarity with Azure cost management, Apptio, and cloud billing structures.   Understanding of server migration strategies and workload cost modeling.   Ability to translate technical data into insights for technical teams and managers.     Preferred Qualifications     FinOps certification or training.   Experience with Azure Reserved Instances and Just-In-Time (JIT) capacity planning.   Knowledge of enterprise architecture and strategic IT planning frameworks. skills.source: Ampcus Inc. is a certified global provider of a broad range of Technology and Business consulting services. We are in search of a highly motivated candidate to join our talented Team.      Job Title:  Software Engineer 2   Location:  Austin, TX.         Description of Services:    Client requires the services of 1 Software Engineer 2, hereafter referred to as Candidate(s), who meets the general qualifications of Software Engineer 2, Applications/Software Development and the specifications outlined in this document for the Client.    All work products resulting from the project shall be considered "works made for hire" and are the property of the Client and may include pre-selection requirements that potential Vendors (and their Candidates) submit to and satisfy criminal background checks as authorized by Texas law.     Work involves highly advanced (senior-level) systems administration in support of agency mainframe applications and supporting infrastructure; and coordinate day-to-day system administration functions such as mainframe configuration, break/fix system support, and base user account creation/support.   Routine system administration functions to include security administration support, performance monitoring, security monitoring, and system maintenance.   Work includes supporting data entry and control work processes, overseeing and coordinating mainframe operations in the State’s Consolidated Data Center Services (DCS), and working with the Network Administration, Customer Support and Applications Development & Support teams to provide support necessary for day-to-day mainframe operations.   Experience with Informatica Power Exchange Administration for Change Data Capture processing using mainframe data sources and targets (i.e., IMS and VSAM) a plus.     The Worker will apply their expert knowledge and experience as a Mainframe z/OS Systems Programmer to support both the needs of the Legacy Systems as well as those for the Mainframe Transformation Team.     Worker Skills and Qualifications:     Provide primary support as the subject matter expert for z/OS operating systems and system components; provide direct technical support as needed in the planning, implementation and testing of releases, upgrades, or changes to z/OS operating system, network, and component software.   Provide end user support for assigned Independent Software Vendor (ISV) products such as Blue Zone.   Provide primary administration and end user support for SCLM.   Provide input and recommendations for hardware capacity planning.   Provide primary administrative support for CICS® and IMS™.   Diagnose platform, software, and related product issues and follow up with root cause analysis.   Analyze performance issues and provide input and recommendations for capacity planning.   Provide input and recommendations for system-wide performance tuning to meet required levels of service.   Provide input and recommendations for system parameters and system libraries management.   Provide support for technical consultation and inquiries from the other IT technical teams.   Provide support as technical lead on internal team projects or participate on project teams that impact the z/OS platform.   Provide support for Integration-testing new products with existing applications and user procedures.   Assist with maintaining and providing technical support for Mainframe Production Control and Support Jobs and monthly Mainframe Job Scheduler.     II. CANDIDATE SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS   Minimum Requirements:     5 Years Required: Experience with z/OS Systems Programming.   5 Years Required: Experience with JES2, z/OS Unix System Services (OMVS), Storage Management Subsystem (SMS).   3 Years Required: Experience with TSS (Top Secret Security).   3 Years Required: Experience with performance monitoring to include initial analysis of performance issues.   2 Years Required: Experience with REXX.   3 Years Preferred: Experience with Informatica Power Exchange Administration.   3 Years Preferred: Working knowledge for each of the following: z/OS Operation, z/OS Networking – VTAM (Virtual Telecommunications Access Method), TCP/IP (Transmission Control Protocol/Internet Protocol).   3 Years Preferred: Working knowledge for each of the following: z/OS-centric automated job scheduling and management software (JOBTRAC), Terminal Emulator Software (BLUEZONE), VTAM Session Manager Software (VTAM/SWITCH).   3 Years Preferred: Working knowledge for each of the following: SMP/E (System Modification Program/Extended), RMF (Resource Measurement Facility), SMF (System Management Facility), WLM (Workload Management), JCL (Job Control Language).   3 Years Preferred: Working knowledge for each of the following: GRS (Global Resource Serialization), VSAM (Virtual Storage Access Method), TSO (Time Sharing Option).   3 Years Preferred: Experience with TLS configuration (certificates, SSL – RSA Keys, SFTP, FTPS).   3 Years Preferred: Experience with SCLM (or other similar configuration management .tools), specifically configuration and administration of SCLM.   3 Years Preferred: Experience with CPM for JOBTRAC.           Ampcus is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veterans, or individuals with disabilities.

skills.label: C++
skills.source: Overview  Client is seeking a Software Engineer to support embedded software development for equipment control systems. This role focuses on developing and integrating software solutions for embedded hardware using C/C++, with an emphasis on controls logic and human-machine interfaces.  You will work closely with cross-functional engineering teams to develop, test, and deliver secure, high-quality embedded software solutions throughout the software development lifecycle.     Core Responsibilities  • Design and implement secure, high-quality embedded software solutions for equipment controls.  • Collaborate with software, firmware, controls, hardware, and applications teams to ensure effective subsystem integration.  • Support the full software development lifecycle, including requirements, design documentation, prototyping, implementation, and unit testing.  • Deliver secure, high-quality software products in a timely manner.  • Contribute to a collaborative engineering environment and support continuous improvement initiatives.     Essential Qualifications, Skills, and Technologies  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field.  • Minimum 2 years of hands-on embedded software development experience; recent graduates with successful internship or co-op experience are encouraged to apply.  • Strong software design and programming skills using C/C++.  • Experience with development tools such as Git and Jira.  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with excellent attention to detail.  • Ability to work on-site in New Freedom, Pennsylvania.     Work Details  • On-site role located in New Freedom, PA. The engineer will work with distributed software applications that coordinate imaging, motion, I/O, sequencing, and data handling for product inspection and quality control. The role also includes evaluating and applying AI-assisted software development practices to improve engineering workflows and productivity.     Core Responsibilities  • Design, develop, test, maintain, and support software for industrial measurement and machine vision systems using C#/.NET.  • Develop and support distributed measurement system applications, including software communication, coordination, configuration, and data handling.  • Support software build, release, deployment, system integration, and technology transfer activities from development into manufacturing.  • Evaluate, adopt, and apply AI-assisted and agentic coding tools to improve software development workflows, code quality, testing, and engineering efficiency.  • Contribute to best practices for incorporating AI development tools into day-to-day software engineering activities.  • Create and maintain technical documentation, including software specifications and support documentation.  • Train engineering, maintenance, and operations personnel on the use, support, and maintenance of deployed systems.  • Provide remote and onsite troubleshooting for software and integrated measurement systems.     Essential Qualifications, Skills, and Technologies  • BS, MS, or PhD preferred in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Optical Engineering, Physics, or a related field.  • Experience developing software applications in C#/.NET for production use, system integration, or industrial applications.  • Experience designing, developing, and troubleshooting software for distributed, multi-process, or integrated systems.  • Familiarity with software communication and messaging methods such as publish/subscribe architectures, message queues, or similar approaches.  • Experience with source control, software versioning, and build/release workflows using tools such as Git, GitLab, automated build systems, and package management tools.  • Experience supporting software deployment, troubleshooting, and long-term support in development or manufacturing environments.  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document technical work and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.  • Interest in applying AI-assisted and agentic coding tools to improve software development workflows, code quality, testing, and engineering productivity.     Preferred Skills or Experience  • Experience with WPF user interface development frameworks in .NET.  • Experience with motion control systems, cameras, image acquisition hardware, and integrated imaging platforms.  • Hands-on experience working with imaging hardware, cameras, measurement equipment, or related instrumentation.  • Experience applying machine learning or computer vision methods to inspection, classification, or measurement problems.  • Familiarity with databases, containerization, or high-performance computing environments.  • Experience evaluating, adopting, or helping define best practices for AI-enabled software development workflows.  • Knowledge of machine vision and image processing methods such as feature extraction, edge detection, morphology, classification, inspection, and metrology.  • Experience with machine vision or image processing libraries such as Halcon, OpenCV, LabVIEW, or similar tools.     Work Details  • 40 hours per week with a flexible schedule as needed.  • Up to 10% to 30% domestic and international travel may be required, with trips ranging from one day to several weeks.  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States.    Nesco Resource offers a comprehensive benefits package for our associates, which includes a MEC (Minimum Essential Coverage) plan that encompasses Medical, Vision, Dental, 401K, and EAP (Employee Assistance Program) services.     Nesco Resource provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

skills.source: A major client of ours has a need for a Data Analyst/Scientist. This is a long-term contract (Potentially 2 years) and the position is remote but EST/CST is preferred.   Position Overview   We are seeking a  Data Analyst/Scientist  to support a Customer Analytics and Digital Products team within a large utility organization. This role will analyze large-scale utility and customer datasets, identify trends and data quality issues, develop dashboards and reporting, and provide actionable insights that support customer-facing digital products and business initiatives.   The ideal candidate has meaningful  utility industry and AMI (Advanced Metering Infrastructure) data experience , strong analytical and data validation skills, and the ability to translate complex technical findings into clear business recommendations.   Key Responsibilities     Analyze large utility datasets, including  AMI usage, Customer Care & Billing (CC&B), and customer engagement data .   Review and validate data extracts, vendor dashboards, and multi-source datasets for  data quality issues, anomalies, trends, and common themes .   Develop and maintain  Power BI dashboards, reports, visualizations, and recurring reporting  to track key business and customer metrics.   Analyze customer engagement, product performance, billing outcomes, and other key performance indicators.   Support customer-facing digital products, including  rate recommendation and bill comparison tools , using historical usage and billing data.   Track and analyze website and digital product engagement, including page views, clicks, and customer interactions.   Partner with  Product Owners, engineers, business SMEs, and other stakeholders  to support data integrations, testing, validation, and product enhancements.   Investigate data discrepancies and anomalies and help identify root causes and potential solutions.   Translate complex analytical findings into clear, actionable insights and recommendations for both technical and business stakeholders.   Manage multiple priorities while maintaining a high level of accuracy and attention to detail in a regulated utility environment.     Required Qualifications & Critical Skills     2+ years of professional data analysis experience , including experience analyzing large data extracts or datasets.   Hands-on utility industry and AMI data experience is required.  Candidates without meaningful utility and AMI experience should not be submitted.   Fundamental understanding of  utility customer usage data  and related business processes.   Strong experience identifying  trends, anomalies, common themes, and data quality issues  within large datasets.   Hands-on experience with  Power BI  for dashboards, reporting, and data visualization.   Experience working with  large, multi-source datasets , including Databricks or comparable data platforms.   Strong data validation, analytical, and problem-solving skills.   Excellent attention to detail and ability to work effectively in a regulated environment.   Strong written and verbal communication skills.   Ability to collaborate effectively with technical and business stakeholders and translate technical findings into clear business recommendations.   Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently in a project-focused environment.   Bachelor’s degree required.     Preferred Qualifications     Experience with  Customer Care & Billing (CC&B)  data and tools.   Experience with  Google Analytics  or similar digital engagement analytics platforms.   Experience analyzing website and digital product engagement, including page views, clicks, and customer interactions.   Experience developing dashboards, recurring reports, data visualizations, and analytics supporting  customer-facing digital products .   Experience supporting data integrations, testing, validation, and product improvement initiatives within a utility environment.     Technology Requirements   Must Have     AMI / Advanced Metering Infrastructure data   Utility usage data   Power BI   Databricks and/or experience working with large, multi-source datasets     Nice to Have     Customer Care & Billing (CC&B)   Google Analytics   Digital engagement analytics   Customer-facing digital product analytics   Dashboard and visualization development     Success in This Role   Success in this role will be demonstrated by the ability to:     Deliver accurate, actionable analysis of complex utility and customer datasets.   Identify and communicate meaningful trends, anomalies, and data quality issues.   Develop clear dashboards and visualizations that enable stakeholders to understand key metrics.   Support reliable data integrations, testing, and validation for customer-facing digital products.   Collaborate effectively with Product Owners, engineers, and business stakeholders.   Turn complex data findings into practical recommendations that improve products, processes, and customer experiences.      Nesco Resource offers a comprehensive benefits package for our associates, which includes a MEC (Minimum Essential Coverage) plan that encompasses Medical, Vision, Dental, 401K, and EAP (Employee Assistance Program) services.    Nesco Resource provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.    PRO038

skills.source: Job Summary We are seeking a Data Scientist with expertise in data science and operations research to develop predictive models and optimization solutions. The role focuses on time-series forecasting, machine learning, and improving demand planning across products, regions, and business segments. The Data Scientist will develop SQL-based ETL processes and data pipelines, collaborate with data engineering teams, and establish governance and monitoring practices to ensure model outputs are accurate, explainable, auditable, and production-ready. Key Responsibilities •    Develop and deploy time-series forecasting and machine learning models to improve demand planning across products, regions, and business segments. •    Apply operations research and optimization techniques to improve outcomes using available resources and operational capabilities. •    Develop and maintain SQL-based ETL processes and data pipelines supporting optimization models, scenario analysis, and production deployment. •    Partner with data engineering teams to ensure the quality, availability, and integrity of model inputs. •    Incorporate demand variability, lead times, network structure, service policies, and operational constraints into model inputs and optimization solutions. •    Establish governance, monitoring, and documentation practices to ensure model outputs are accurate, explainable, auditable, and production-ready. Required Qualifications •    Experience in data science, predictive modeling, and machine learning. •    Experience with time-series forecasting and demand planning. •    Knowledge of operations research and optimization techniques. •    Experience developing and maintaining SQL-based ETL processes and data pipelines. •    Ability to collaborate with data engineering teams to maintain data quality, availability, and integrity. •    Understanding of model governance, monitoring, explainability, auditability, and production deployment.

skills.label: CI/CD
skills.source: Job Summary The Machine Learning Builder will develop, deploy, and operate production-grade AI, machine learning, and analytical solutions across Claims and Payment Integrity, Customer Service, and Technology workflows within the healthcare domain. The role focuses on advanced analytics, anomaly detection, predictive modeling, and multimodal AI systems that combine structured data, natural language processing, embeddings, deep learning, and generative AI. The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong technical ownership and a production-focused mindset while delivering scalable, secure, maintainable, and explainable ML solutions that address complex business problems. Key Responsibilities •    Design, build, deploy, and operate production AI, machine learning, and analytical systems focused on claims integrity, customer service, and technology workflows. •    Develop and integrate multimodal systems combining structured data, natural language processing (NLP), embeddings, deep learning, and generative AI to improve decision-making and output explainability. •    Engineer robust feature pipelines, population and target definitions, model evaluation frameworks, and scoring architectures. •    Implement model explainability, monitoring, and drift detection to maintain model quality and reliability. •    Collaborate with MLOps, data engineering, and platform teams to ensure CI/CD, observability, security, compliance, and auditability of deployed models and services. •    Provide operational support for ML systems, including troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and continuous improvement in production environments. •    Apply modern software engineering practices, including source control, automated testing, infrastructure as code, containers, and deployment automation. •    Conduct data discovery, curation, and integration activities, diagnosing and resolving data pipeline issues as needed. •    Collaborate with AI/Automation and business teams to design end-to-end solutions that deliver measurable operational and business outcomes. •    Work independently in ambiguous environments, make sound technical trade-offs, and deliver high-velocity, reviewable work. Required Qualifications •    Hands-on experience developing and deploying production-grade AI, machine learning, and analytical systems. •    Experience with advanced analytics, anomaly detection, predictive modeling, and production AI solutions. •    Experience developing multimodal AI systems using structured data, NLP, embeddings, deep learning, and generative AI. •    Knowledge of feature engineering, model evaluation, scoring architectures, model explainability, monitoring, and drift detection. •    Experience collaborating with MLOps, data engineering, and platform teams to support production model deployment. •    Understanding of CI/CD, observability, security, compliance, and auditability requirements for ML systems. •    Experience with source control, automated testing, infrastructure as code, containers, and deployment automation. •    Ability to perform data discovery, data curation, data integration, and pipeline troubleshooting. •    Strong problem-solving skills, technical ownership, and the ability to translate complex business problems into maintainable analytical solutions. •    Ability to work autonomously, make sound technical decisions, and deliver solutions in fast-paced and ambiguous environments.

evidence.text: Jenkins Docker Kubernetes CI/CD for 20 engineers; deploy 6h to 90s; 20+ releases/month.
