The role focuses on advanced analytics, anomaly detection, predictive modeling, and multimodal AI systems that combine structured data, natural language processing, embeddings, deep learning, and generative AI. The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong technical ownership and a production-focused mindset while delivering scalable, secure, maintainable, and explainable ML solutions that address complex business problems. Key Responsibilities •    Design, build, deploy, and operate production AI, machine learning, and analytical systems focused on claims integrity, customer service, and technology workflows. •    Develop and integrate multimodal systems combining structured data, natural language processing (NLP), embeddings, deep learning, and generative AI to improve decision-making and output explainability. •    Engineer robust feature pipelines, population and target definitions, model evaluation frameworks, and scoring architectures. •    Implement model explainability, monitoring, and drift detection to maintain model quality and reliability. •    Collaborate with MLOps, data engineering, and platform teams to ensure CI/CD, observability, security, compliance, and auditability of deployed models and services. •    Provide operational support for ML systems, including troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and continuous improvement in production environments. •    Apply modern software engineering practices, including source control, automated testing, infrastructure as code, containers, and deployment automation. •    Conduct data discovery, curation, and integration activities, diagnosing and resolving data pipeline issues as needed. •    Collaborate with AI/Automation and business teams to design end-to-end solutions that deliver measurable operational and business outcomes. •    Work independently in ambiguous environments, make sound technical trade-offs, and deliver high-velocity, reviewable work. Required Qualifications •    Hands-on experience developing and deploying production-grade AI, machine learning, and analytical systems. •    Experience with advanced analytics, anomaly detection, predictive modeling, and production AI solutions. •    Experience developing multimodal AI systems using structured data, NLP, embeddings, deep learning, and generative AI. •    Knowledge of feature engineering, model evaluation, scoring architectures, model explainability, monitoring, and drift detection. •    Experience collaborating with MLOps, data engineering, and platform teams to support production model deployment. •    Understanding of CI/CD, observability, security, compliance, and auditability requirements for ML systems. •    Experience with source control, automated testing, infrastructure as code, containers, and deployment automation. •    Ability to perform data discovery, data curation, data integration, and pipeline troubleshooting. •    Strong problem-solving skills, technical ownership, and the ability to translate complex business problems into maintainable analytical solutions. •    Ability to work autonomously, make sound technical decisions, and deliver solutions in fast-paced and ambiguous environments.

evidence.text: Forecasted stroke patients' functional outcomes at 6, 12 and 24 months with PyTorch and scikit-learn machine learning models, using Claude summaries of 10K+ similar patients from a 90-field thrombectomy registry.

skills.label: Python
skills.source: Job Title: Agronomic Modeling -- Data Scientist   Location: Remote.  Duration :12 Months   Introduction   We are seeking a technically skilled individual to support the development of Genotype x Environment x Management models that provide agronomic insights for internal stakeholders and farmers. This individual will leverage large agricultural datasets from connected equipment (planters, sprayers, combines, etc.), weather data, soil maps, satellite and drone imagery, and other sources to build scalable agronomic decision-support models to improve productivity, profitability, and sustainability in corn, soybean, and cotton production systems. They will be responsible for ensuring that agronomic models are agronomically reasonable, properly calibrated and validated, transparent in their assumptions, and appropriate for the crops, geographies, and management systems in which they are deployed.   Required Skills & Qualifications     Experience developing, calibrating, validating, and applying APSIM, DSSAT, or comparable process-based crop models for agricultural decision support.   Strong understanding of crop physiology, phenology, soil water dynamics, nutrient cycling, and their influence on crop response to management and environment.   Strong understanding of at least one major US row crop production system, with expertise in corn and soybean production preferred.   Advanced proficiency in R and/or Python for data analysis, simulation workflows, and model development.   Experience working with Databricks, SQL, cloud computing environments, APIs, for scalable analytical and simulation workflows.   Demonstrated experience with AI assisted development.   Experience working with large multi-environment, multi-year, or multi-management agricultural datasets and developing reproducible analytical workflows.   Ability to communicate model assumptions, results, limitations, and uncertainty to both technical and nontechnical audiences.   Experience translating scientific models or research outputs into practical decision-support tools, recommendations, or operational workflows for growers.   Master’s or Ph.D. in agronomy, crop science, soil science, biological systems engineering, agricultural engineering, quantitative genetics, or a closely related discipline.   Prior work experience at client or in client's Industry.     Applicants must be able to work directly for Artech on W2.   Preferred Skills & Qualifications     Experience with John Deere Operations Center and precision agriculture technologies including planting, spraying, harvest, automation, sensing, and variable-rate management systems.   Familiarity with machine-generated datasets and common grower-facing agronomic data layers (field boundaries, management zones, digital elevation models).   Experience working in agricultural industry with agronomic model development.   Experience developing agronomic constraints or validation systems for AI-generated recommendations.   Experience integrating drone and satellite data into analytics pipelines.   Proficiency in SQL, R, Python, Tableau, Power BI, or similar tools.     Day-to-Day Responsibilities     Develop modeling approaches for G x E x M interactions to predict the outcomes of various management scenarios (planting date, variety selection, fertility management, crop care, etc.) in corn, soybean and cotton production systems across diverse geographies.   Design and execute model calibration, validation, and sensitivity analyses to quantify model performance, uncertainty, and limitations across geographies, years, and management systems.   Understand interactions among genotype, weather, soil, management, and cropping history to clearly define modeling problems, input requirements, outputs, assumptions, and validation criteria.   Work with large, machine-generated agricultural datasets including planter, sprayer, harvest data.   Work with large geospatial datasets including soil maps, topography, multispectral imagery, remote sensing products, and environmental data layers.   Develop repeatable workflows for processing, summarizing, and visualizing outcomes of these models.   Develop agronomic logic, constraints, and validation frameworks that ensure AI-generated recommendations are agronomically sound, transparent, and scientifically defensible.   Collaborate with agronomists, data scientists, software developers, and product managers to build, scale, and communicate outcomes of these models.     Company Benefits & Culture     Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance plans.   Flexible working hours and remote work opportunities.   Professional development and continuous learning opportunities.     For immediate consideration please click APPLY to begin the screening process with Alex.

skills.source: Job Summary:  The Productivity Solutions Team is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining innovative solutions that drive business efficiency, productivity, and customer satisfaction. The Software Engineer - IV will be responsible for maintaining and supporting a custom SharePoint Framework (SPFx) application used by the district. The role requires strong front-end development expertise, including React, JavaScript, TypeScript, React Router, modern CSS, component design, accessibility best practices, API integration, CI/CD practices, and Python, along with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams. Key Responsibilities • Maintain and support the custom SharePoint Framework (SPFx) application used by the district. • Develop and maintain reusable, scalable, and maintainable React components. • Build and enhance front-end functionality using React, JavaScript, and TypeScript. • Implement and maintain application routing using React Router. • Integrate and consume APIs to support application functionality. • Apply component design principles and modern CSS practices to deliver effective user experiences. • Consume and work within established design systems to maintain consistency across applications. • Apply accessibility best practices throughout application development and maintenance. • Work with SharePoint and SharePoint Lists to support application functionality. • Follow CI/CD practices for application development, testing, and deployment. • Troubleshoot and debug production issues with strong attention to detail and analytical problem-solving. • Collaborate with cross-functional teams and clearly communicate technical concepts and requirements to non-technical stakeholders. • Stay current with platform features, development practices, and evolving technical standards. Required Qualifications • Strong hands-on experience with React. • Strong proficiency in JavaScript and TypeScript. • Experience with React Router. • Experience working with and consuming APIs. • Experience consuming and working with established design systems. • Strong component design skills. • Proficiency with modern CSS. • Strong understanding of accessibility best practices. • Experience with CI/CD practices. • Working knowledge of Python. • Basic understanding of SharePoint and SharePoint Lists. • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills, including the ability to troubleshoot production issues. • Strong communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts and requirements to non-technical stakeholders. Preferred Qualifications • Experience maintaining and supporting SharePoint Framework (SPFx) applications. • Experience working in a Productivity Solutions or business efficiency-focused technology environment. • Ability to adapt to new platform features and stay current with evolving development best practices.

skills.source: Job Summary We are seeking an experienced Full Stack Java Developer with strong hands-on expertise in Java API and backend development, along with secondary experience in React UI development. The ideal candidate will have experience building scalable REST APIs and microservices using Java and Spring Boot and contributing to modern React-based user interfaces. A key requirement is practical experience using AI-assisted development tools and Vibe Coding, Spec-Driven Development, or similar approaches to accelerate code development, testing, documentation, refactoring, troubleshooting, and delivery. Key Responsibilities •    Design, develop, and maintain Java-based REST APIs and microservices using Spring Boot. •    Develop secure, scalable, reusable backend services and integrations. •    Contribute to React-based UI development where required. •    Integrate frontend applications with Java APIs and backend services. •    Apply Vibe Coding or Spec-Driven Development practices using AI coding tools to improve development productivity. •    Translate functional requirements and specifications into working code using AI-assisted development tools. •    Review, validate, test, and refine AI-generated code to ensure it meets functional and engineering standards. •    Use AI tools for code generation, unit testing, refactoring, troubleshooting, and technical documentation. •    Develop unit tests and support automated testing using JUnit, Mockito, and related tools. •    Create and maintain API specifications using Swagger/OpenAPI. •    Troubleshoot application and API issues across backend and frontend components. •    Participate in code reviews and follow established coding, security, testing, and engineering standards. •    Collaborate with Product Owners, Architects, QA, DevOps, and other engineering teams. Required Qualifications •    Strong hands-on experience with Java 11, 17, or 21. •    Strong expertise in Spring Boot, Spring MVC, and Spring Security. •    Proven experience designing and developing RESTful APIs and microservices. •    Strong understanding of API design, JSON, integration patterns, and backend application architecture. •    Experience with JPA/Hibernate and relational database integration. •    Ability to develop scalable, maintainable, and testable backend services. •    Hands-on experience using AI coding tools as part of day-to-day software development. •    Experience with Vibe Coding, Spec-Driven Development, or similar AI-assisted development approaches. •    Ability to translate functional requirements or specifications into working code with the assistance of AI development tools. •    Experience using AI tools for code generation, unit testing, refactoring, troubleshooting, and technical documentation. •    Experience with React.js and modern frontend development. •    Working knowledge of TypeScript/JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3. •    Experience developing responsive web applications and Single Page Applications (SPAs). •    Ability to integrate React applications with backend REST APIs. •    Experience with JUnit and Mockito. •    Understanding of Test-Driven Development (TDD) and automated unit testing. •    Hands-on experience with Postman. •    Experience with Swagger/OpenAPI for API documentation and validation. •    Strong working knowledge of SQL. •    Experience with PostgreSQL and/or Oracle. •    Experience with Git and standard source-control practices. •    Experience with Maven and/or Gradle. •    Understanding of CI/CD pipelines. •    Experience with Jenkins, GitHub, and/or GitLab. •    Working knowledge of Docker. Preferred Qualifications •    Exposure to MongoDB or other NoSQL databases. •    Experience with Kafka or other messaging and event-driven technologies. •    Exposure to Kubernetes and/or OpenShift. •    Exposure to AWS or Azure. •    Experience with modern AI-assisted software development practices. Notes: Mandatory Areas Must Have Skills • Backend/API: Java 11/17/21, Spring Boot, Spring MVC/Security, RESTful APIs, Microservices, JSON, JPA/Hibernate. • Frontend: React.js, TypeScript/JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, responsive UI / SPA development. • Testing/API tools: JUnit, Mockito, TDD, Postman, Swagger/OpenAPI. • Data & Integration: SQL, PostgreSQL/Oracle; MongoDB; Kafka/messaging preferred. • DevOps/Cloud: Git, Maven/Gradle, CI/CD, Jenkins/GitHub/GitLab, Docker, Kubernetes/OpenShift; AWS/Azure exposure. Domain Experience (If any) – Good to have healthcare experience Must have Certifications – None Location - Remote Onsite Requirement - Remote Number of days onsite - Remote

skills.source: Senior Software Engineer, Capital Markets Data Engineering We are not accepting C2C or 1099 arrangements. Location:  Charlotte, NC, Uptown Work Model:  Hybrid, 3 days per week in office Contract Duration:  12 months, with intent to extend up to 24 months Primary Technical Requirement:  SQL Server expertise About the Role We are seeking an experienced  Software/Data Engineer  to join a Capital Markets Investment Banking Technology team in Charlotte, NC. In this role, you will help support the expansion and modernization of front-office technology capabilities, with a particular focus on  risk, capital, and data modernization . You will design and develop scalable solutions within the existing technology ecosystem, helping strengthen the current platform while creating reusable products and services that can be leveraged by other applications. The ideal candidate brings  strong SQL Server expertise , hands-on Python development experience, and a solid background building data-intensive or distributed applications. What You’ll Do Analyze and interpret the organization’s  Data Modernization strategy  across impacted technology and business disciplines. Design, develop, and implement scalable, high-quality data solutions. Partner with business and technology stakeholders to define and formalize business requirements. Translate business requirements into detailed technical requirements and solution designs. Develop applications and data solutions using  SQL Server and Python . Build and support distributed applications, microservices, and RESTful APIs. Develop reusable technology components that can be integrated with other internal applications. Participate in Agile development workstreams and manage development activities through Jira. Collaborate with engineering, risk, capital, and front-office technology teams. Leverage DevOps practices and tools to support automated development, testing, and deployment. Help improve engineering efficiency and increase delivery capacity within the Agile development environment. Minimum Qualifications Strong hands-on expertise with  Microsoft SQL Server , including advanced SQL development and working with relational data. Professional software development or programming experience using  Python . Experience in  data engineering and/or full-stack application development . Experience using Python data-processing frameworks or libraries such as  Pandas, Polars, PyTorch, or similar technologies . Experience designing or developing  distributed applications . Experience working with relational database platforms such as  SQL Server, Oracle, DB2, or similar technologies . Experience designing or working within  microservices architectures . Experience developing and integrating  RESTful APIs . Experience with DevOps and CI/CD tools such as  Git, Jenkins, and automated deployment toolkits . Experience working within an  Agile software development environment . Preferred Qualifications Experience with  Test-Driven Development (TDD) . Experience working within  Capital Markets , particularly investment banking or front-office technology. Familiarity with risk disciplines, including  Market Risk and Counterparty Credit Risk . Knowledge of  derivative products, financial risk management, and financial product data modeling . Experience or familiarity with  Generative AI and Agentic AI technologies . What Will Help You Succeed You’ll be successful in this role if you are comfortable working across both business and technology teams, can translate complex requirements into scalable technical solutions, and enjoy solving data-intensive problems in a fast-paced environment. Because of the role’s focus, candidates should have particularly strong experience with  SQL Server and relational data architectures , complemented by solid Python development skills. Candidates who are open to relocating to Charlotte may also be considered. Work Location Charlotte, North Carolina, Uptown This is a hybrid position requiring employees to work  onsite 3 days per week . skills.source: Software Engineer| Full Stack Java We are not accepting C2C or 1099 arrangements. Locations:  Irving, TX or Chandler, AZ Primary Irving Location:  401 Las Colinas Blvd W, Building A, Irving, TX Line of Business:  TCOO Contract Duration:  18 months, with potential for extension or conversion Work Arrangement:  Hybrid,  3 days per week onsite required Openings:  1 About the Role We are seeking a  Software Engineer / Full Stack Java Developer  to join a team responsible for a suite of applications supporting Currency Transaction Reporting (CTR) and transaction monitoring. In this role, you will contribute to the maintenance, modernization, and consolidation of five existing applications into a more unified platform. You will work across the technology stack, with a strong focus on  Java, Spring Boot, and React , while contributing to REST APIs, microservices, cloud-native development, and data processing initiatives. The ideal candidate is a hands-on developer who learns quickly, works effectively with distributed Agile teams, and is comfortable contributing to both existing applications and modernization efforts. What You'll Do Design, develop, test, and maintain full-stack applications using  Java, Spring Boot, and React.js . Build and support  REST APIs and microservices  for enterprise applications. Maintain and enhance existing applications while supporting efforts to consolidate multiple applications into a unified solution. Help stabilize and modernize front-end applications using  React and modern JavaScript frameworks . Apply software design patterns, secure coding practices, and application performance optimization techniques. Participate in code reviews, troubleshooting, testing, and ongoing application improvements. Work with  Python  for automation, scripting, data processing, and related development initiatives. Contribute to data pipeline development and processing using technologies such as  Python and Apache Spark . Support cloud-native application development, with exposure to  Google Cloud Platform (GCP)  preferred. Collaborate with cross-functional and geographically distributed teams in an  Agile/Scrum environment . Research and evaluate technical solutions and recommend approaches for low-to-moderately complex engineering challenges. Identify opportunities to improve development processes, application stability, maintainability, and performance. Leverage modern developer productivity and AI-assisted development tools, including  GitHub Copilot . Follow applicable technology, security, compliance, and development standards. Minimum Qualifications 2+ years of Software Engineering experience , demonstrated through a combination of professional experience, consulting experience, training, military experience, or education. 2+ years of hands-on Java development experience . Experience developing applications with  Spring/Spring Boot . Hands-on experience with  React.js  or a comparable modern front-end framework such as Angular. Experience developing and consuming  REST APIs . Experience working with  microservices architectures . Understanding of software design patterns and object-oriented development principles. Understanding of  secure coding practices  and application performance optimization. Working knowledge of  Python , including its use in scripting, automation, or data processing. Experience working in  Agile/Scrum environments  with cross-functional or distributed teams. Ability to work onsite  3 days per week  at the assigned Irving, TX or Chandler, AZ location. Preferred Qualifications Experience with  Google Cloud Platform (GCP)  or another major cloud platform. Experience developing  cloud-native applications . Experience with  Kubernetes and/or OpenShift Container Platform (OCP) . Experience with  Apache Spark  and data pipelines. Exposure to  AI/ML technologies or AI-assisted software development tools . Experience with  GitHub Copilot  or similar AI development tools. Experience supporting application modernization, migration, or consolidation initiatives. Financial services experience is not required. What We're Looking For Successful candidates will be: Strong problem solvers with solid software engineering fundamentals. Comfortable working across both back-end and front-end technologies. Quick learners who are open to developing new cloud, data, and AI-related skills. Collaborative and effective in cross-functional team environments. Able to work independently while knowing when to engage teammates for input. Adaptable and comfortable supporting both existing applications and modernization projects. Committed to the required hybrid work schedule. Work Environment Hybrid:  3 days per week onsite is mandatory. Overtime:  Not expected. After-hours releases:  Participation in off-hours release calls is not expected. Contract:  18 months, with the possibility of extension or conversion. Internal / Supplier Notes | Do Not Include in Public Job Posting Position is a  backfill . All candidate resumes  must be submitted through Beeline  to be considered. Suppliers should not contact or solicit the hiring/reporting manager while the position is active. Do not submit resumes outside of the approved Beeline process. Primary skill priorities: Java Spring Boot React Python Preferred additional skills: GCP, Kubernetes/OCP, Spark. Financial services experience is  not required .  			  			 Medical, dental, and vision insurance are available to qualified candidates who meet eligibility requirements.

In this role, you will contribute to the maintenance, modernization, and consolidation of five existing applications into a more unified platform. You will work across the technology stack, with a strong focus on  Java, Spring Boot, and React , while contributing to REST APIs, microservices, cloud-native development, and data processing initiatives. The ideal candidate is a hands-on developer who learns quickly, works effectively with distributed Agile teams, and is comfortable contributing to both existing applications and modernization efforts. What You'll Do Design, develop, test, and maintain full-stack applications using  Java, Spring Boot, and React.js . Build and support  REST APIs and microservices  for enterprise applications. Maintain and enhance existing applications while supporting efforts to consolidate multiple applications into a unified solution. Help stabilize and modernize front-end applications using  React and modern JavaScript frameworks . Apply software design patterns, secure coding practices, and application performance optimization techniques. Participate in code reviews, troubleshooting, testing, and ongoing application improvements. Work with  Python  for automation, scripting, data processing, and related development initiatives. Contribute to data pipeline development and processing using technologies such as  Python and Apache Spark . Support cloud-native application development, with exposure to  Google Cloud Platform (GCP)  preferred. Collaborate with cross-functional and geographically distributed teams in an  Agile/Scrum environment . Research and evaluate technical solutions and recommend approaches for low-to-moderately complex engineering challenges. Identify opportunities to improve development processes, application stability, maintainability, and performance. Leverage modern developer productivity and AI-assisted development tools, including  GitHub Copilot . Follow applicable technology, security, compliance, and development standards. Minimum Qualifications 2+ years of Software Engineering experience , demonstrated through a combination of professional experience, consulting experience, training, military experience, or education. 2+ years of hands-on Java development experience . Experience developing applications with  Spring/Spring Boot . Hands-on experience with  React.js  or a comparable modern front-end framework such as Angular. Experience developing and consuming  REST APIs . Experience working with  microservices architectures . Understanding of software design patterns and object-oriented development principles. Understanding of  secure coding practices  and application performance optimization. Working knowledge of  Python , including its use in scripting, automation, or data processing. Experience working in  Agile/Scrum environments  with cross-functional or distributed teams. Ability to work onsite  3 days per week  at the assigned Irving, TX or Chandler, AZ location. Preferred Qualifications Experience with  Google Cloud Platform (GCP)  or another major cloud platform. Experience developing  cloud-native applications . Experience with  Kubernetes and/or OpenShift Container Platform (OCP) . Experience with  Apache Spark  and data pipelines. Exposure to  AI/ML technologies or AI-assisted software development tools . Experience with  GitHub Copilot  or similar AI development tools. Experience supporting application modernization, migration, or consolidation initiatives. Financial services experience is not required. What We're Looking For Successful candidates will be: Strong problem solvers with solid software engineering fundamentals. Comfortable working across both back-end and front-end technologies. Quick learners who are open to developing new cloud, data, and AI-related skills. Collaborative and effective in cross-functional team environments. Able to work independently while knowing when to engage teammates for input. Adaptable and comfortable supporting both existing applications and modernization projects. Committed to the required hybrid work schedule. Work Environment Hybrid:  3 days per week onsite is mandatory. Overtime:  Not expected. After-hours releases:  Participation in off-hours release calls is not expected. Contract:  18 months, with the possibility of extension or conversion. Internal / Supplier Notes | Do Not Include in Public Job Posting Position is a  backfill . All candidate resumes  must be submitted through Beeline  to be considered. Suppliers should not contact or solicit the hiring/reporting manager while the position is active. Do not submit resumes outside of the approved Beeline process. Primary skill priorities: Java Spring Boot React Python Preferred additional skills: GCP, Kubernetes/OCP, Spark. Financial services experience is  not required .  			  			 Medical, dental, and vision insurance are available to qualified candidates who meet eligibility requirements.

skills.source: Code Scanning Specialty Engineer We are not accepting C2C or 1099 arrangements. Location:  Columbus, OH (Preferred) or Irving, TX Duration:  12-Month Contract About the Role We are seeking experienced  Code Scanning Specialty Engineers  to help drive secure technology modernization across enterprise platforms. In this role, you will design and implement automated vulnerability detection capabilities that enable developers to securely build, deploy, and scale cloud-native applications, APIs, AI services, and data platforms. You will partner with engineering, security, and platform teams to create enterprise-wide security tooling, integrations, governance frameworks, and automation that improve developer productivity while reducing operational risk. This position combines software engineering, security engineering, cloud technologies, and AI-enabled solutions to support large-scale modernization initiatives. What You'll Do Design, develop, and maintain automated code scanning and vulnerability detection solutions. Build integrations across CI/CD pipelines, developer tools, cloud platforms, and security ecosystems. Create reusable security services, frameworks, and automation capabilities that can be adopted across multiple technology portfolios. Implement secure-by-default development practices for applications, APIs, data services, and AI-powered solutions. Partner with engineering teams to identify and remediate vulnerabilities early in the software development lifecycle. Develop governance controls and reporting capabilities that improve security compliance and visibility. Enable secure cloud-native modernization initiatives by embedding automated security controls into development workflows. Leverage GenAI and automation technologies to enhance security operations and developer experience. Contribute to enterprise standards, best practices, and technical roadmaps for application security and modernization. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Cybersecurity, or equivalent practical experience. Experience building software solutions using  Python ,  Java , and at least one additional programming language such as  Go, Rust, JavaScript, or similar . Experience designing and developing cloud-native applications and services. Experience building automation, tooling, and platform capabilities within engineering environments. Strong systems-thinking mindset with the ability to solve complex technical challenges across multiple domains. Ability to work independently in fast-paced, highly collaborative environments. Preferred Qualifications Experience implementing or integrating  Generative AI (GenAI)  solutions within enterprise environments. Experience with application security, secure software development practices, and vulnerability management. Knowledge of CI/CD platforms, DevSecOps methodologies, and developer enablement tools. Experience working in highly regulated industries such as financial services, healthcare, or government. Familiarity with cybersecurity frameworks, compliance requirements, and security governance models. Proven ability to influence technical strategy and drive adoption of enterprise-scale solutions. Impact In this role, you will: Enable secure modernization of applications, APIs, AI services, and data platforms. Improve data security and regulatory compliance through automated controls. Reduce operational complexity by eliminating manual security review processes. Accelerate software delivery by identifying and addressing vulnerabilities earlier in the development lifecycle. Build scalable, reusable security capabilities that drive enterprise-wide modernization initiatives. Ideal Candidate:  A hands-on engineer who enjoys building solutions, thrives in complex environments, and is passionate about improving security, automation, and developer productivity at scale. Benefits Featured    Medical, Dental , and Vision Insurance is offered to qualified candidates.  			  			 Medical, dental, and vision insurance are available to qualified candidates who meet eligibility requirements.
